notes.title: 8/5 Server maintenance announcement
notes.content:
[b]Server maintenance planned date and time[/b]
From 8/5/2025 (Tue) 4:00 PM (PDT) to 8/6/2025 (Wed) 1:00 AM (PDT)
[previewyoutube=NZImkylMAYA;full][/previewyoutube][h3][/h3][h2][url="https://pso2.com/players/update/2025-08/#update05"][August Update Info][/url][/h2][h1]System updates[/h1]
[h2]Class Skill adjustments[/h2]
[h2]Fighter adjustments[/h2]
[b]Class Skill adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Fighter Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Defeat Advantage[/td][td]Increased Down Potency when used with Main Class.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload Short Cycle[/td][td]Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload After PP Preservation[/td][td]Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fighter Arts Pursuit[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Attack Impact[/td][td]Increased shockwave Potency.
Increased shockwave velocity.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Deadly Archer[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Expanded the attack range.
Changed specifications so that the distance retreated after attacking can be reduced by inputting forward.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spiral Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Changed specifications so that the distance retreated after attacking can be reduced by inputting forward.
Adjusted to allow movement after attacking when inputting left or right while locked on.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Twin Daggers adjustments[/b]
[list][*]Added an omni-directional guard point to the 4th step of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack.[/*][*]Changed specifications for the 4th step of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack so that when attacking mid-air with an enemy within a certain distance, the height of ascent will adjust to the target's height.[/*][*]Increased Potency of Twin Daggers Photon Blast.[/*][*]Increased the approach distance and speed of Twin Daggers Photon Blast when activated while a target is present.[/*][*]Relaxed the vertical approach angle for Twin Daggers Photon Blast.[/*][*]Changed specifications of Twin Daggers Photon Blast so that when attacking on the ground, the character will chase the target into the air.[/*][*]Adjusted Twin Daggers Photon Blast to allow movement while the attack is active.[/*][/list]The following adjustments will be made to Twin Daggers Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Circling Buzzard[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Expanded the attack range of the second half of the attack.
Adjusted the forward guard point of the second half of the attack to be omni-directional and extended.
Eased Hit Stops when attacked by enemies during the second half of the attack.
Adjusted to make the character face the target if no direction is inputted while the second half of the attack is active.
Relaxed the turning timing of the final attack in the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b] Double Saber adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Double Saber Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Julien Dance[/td][td]Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the turn timing of the final attack in the second half.
Added a forward guard point for the final attack in the second half. [/td][/tr][/table]
[b] Knuckles adjustments[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted Knuckles Weapon Action so that players are not moved too close to enemies when attacking on the ground.[/*][/list]The following adjustments will be made to Knuckles Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Swift Rush[/td][td]Adjusted to allow movement when inputting left or right while locked on or in Over-the-Shoulder View during activation of the first half of the attack.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thousand Blows[/td][td]Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed Sidestep cancel timing in the first half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Double Drive[/td][td]Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the jump cancel timing in the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Gunner balance adjustments[/h2]
[b]Class Skill adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Gunner Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger[/td][td]Changed the specifications to increase the Down Factor of Chain Finisher Boost according to the Chain Number.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger Increase[/td][td]Changed the specifications to increase the Down Factor of Chain Finisher Boost according to the Chain Number.
Increased the increase per Chain.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Boost[/td][td]Changed specifications so that if a special armament is equipped while Chain Boost is active, the Attack Speed Up level and remaining effect duration are restored to their previous values upon unequipping the armament.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger Count Retain[/td][td]Increased the Chain Number of the next activated Chain Trigger when a Chain Trigger ends without a Chain Finisher Boost.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stylish Onslaught[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased charge amount of Hail of Bullets gauge.
Expanded the attack range.
Increased movement distance when the enemy is within a certain distance.
Changed specifications to activate invulnerability when nullifying an attack.
Changed specifications to activate the effects of the following Class Skills when nullifying an attack.
[list][*]EChain Boost Advanced[/*][*]EStylish Roll Counter Bullet[/*][*]EStylish Roll Strike Back[/*][*]EStrikeback Advanced[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]Strikeback Advanced[/td][td]Extended the Invulnerability Duration at start of PA charge.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stylish Roll Counter Bullet[/td][td]Increased hit count and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Twin Machine Guns balance adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Machine Guns Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Aimless Rain[/td][td]Adjusted specifications so that there is no forward movement during an attack but to instead move in the direction of input.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Point Blank[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased movement distance when a target is present while locked on or in Over-the-Shoulder View.
Increased movement speed when inputting movement during the attack.
Adjusted to prevent moving too close to the enemy when inputting movement during an attack.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Waker adjustments[/h2]
[b]Class Skill adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Waker Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Familiar Support[/td][td]Expanded enemy search range.
Improved homing ability.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marmelo Strike[/td][td]Increased Stage 2 Potency when successfully nullifying an attack.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marmelo Strike Tracing[/td][td]Improved homing ability.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hot Marmelo Parry[/td][td]Reduced cooldown time.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Harmonizer adjustments[/b]
[list][*]Increased the turning speed during activation of steps 1 to 3 of the Harmonizer Normal Attack.[/*][*]Increased the turning speed during activation of the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Made the Weapon Action cancel timing more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Made the Sidestep Action cancel timing more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Added an omni-direction guard point to the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down. [/*][*]Added launch and knockback resistance to the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Increased animation speed of the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Made the input buffer window more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][/list]The following adjustments will be made to Harmonizer Photon Arts
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Fredran Breath[/td][td]Increased maximum lock-ons for the follow-up attack.
Increased turning speed during activation of the follow-up attack.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fredran Riding[/td][td]Eased the firing angle of the attack when the button is not held down.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wulfen Demolition[/td][td]Increased the turning speed during activation of the second half of the attack performed when the button is not held down.
Increased turning speed during activation of the stage 1 charged attack.
Increased turning speed during activation of the stage 2 charged attack.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Tech Arts Customization adjustments[/h2]
[b]Twin Machine Guns balance adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Machine Guns Tech Arts Customization.
[table][tr][th]Technique[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Aimless Rain[/td][td]Adjusted Type 1 to always maximize Potency Increase based on the distance.[/td][/tr][/table]
PAGE TOP
[hr][/hr][h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list][*]The hit detection for the arms of the following enemies has been adjusted.[list][*]Fortos Laser[/*][*]Fortos Launcher[/*][*]Val Zagga[/*][/list][/*][*]An HP gauge will now be displayed for boss enemies.[/*][*]Some parts of the boss enemy Malignant Dark Falz Vael will now be displayed on the radar map.[/*][*]For the boss enemies Crocodylis and Crocodylis Vera, Throw Actions that hit while the enemy is reacting will now be counted in the number of hits.[/*][/list][h2]Quests and Fields[/h2]
[list][*]Changed specifications for the Quest Info reward display and Quest Reward Details so that if the 1st Clear Reward has already been obtained, its display priority will be lowered.[/*][*]Changed specifications for the Incapacitation Menu of certain quests so that the Retire from Quest option will now be available when playing solo.[/*][*]From the end of maintenance on 8/6/2025 (Wed) (PDT) until the start of maintenance on 9/2/2025 (Tue) (PDT), all Urgent Quests occurring in the Stia Region will be changed to the Urgent Quest: And the Stars Fell D.2.
[u]*During this period, no other Urgent Quests will occur in the Stia Region. Please note that it will also not be possible to earn Titles related to other Urgent Quests in the Stia Region.[/u][/*][/list][h2]Interface[/h2]
[list][*]Changed the number of digits available for inputting Battle Power and Level Restrictions in the Recruitment Settings Menu under Recruit Party Members.[/*][*]For the DPS display, the numbers will now be left-aligned, and the maximum number of digits that can be displayed has been increased.[/*][*]The following changes have been made to the Victory Performance Settings and Select Emote section of the Lookbook. [list][*]The Emote currently selected under the cursor will now be played in the preview.[/*][*]If a button corresponding to a different Emote is pressed, it will be shown in the preview.[/*][/list][/*][*]In the Limited-Time tab of the Task List, the Campaign/Contents category has been split into Campaign and Contents, with Campaign being prioritized in the display.[/*][*]A Recommended tab has been added to the Task List.
The Recommended tab will display Tasks from the Campaign category of the Limited-Time tab.
[u]*If there are no ongoing Campaign Tasks, nothing will be displayed.[/u][/*][*]The window displayed for Select Emote under the Register Looks section of the Lookbook has been updated.[/*][*]An LG1 Rarity option has been added to the Auto Sell Drop Items settings.[/*][*]Leave Party has been added as a Customize Quick Menu option.[/*][*]The item name will now be displayed in the second tab of the weapon item details under the Multi-weapon section.[/*][/list][h2]Character Creation[/h2]
[list][*]Changed the specifications of the Salon so that the Log Window display and chat sending features are now available.[/*][*]The display method for some messages in the Salon has been changed.[/*][/list][h2]Items[/h2]
[list][*]Added the following items to the product list in the Exchange Shop: ARKS Record Badge Exchange.[list][*]* Trunkul Almati[/*][*]* Revita Almati[/*][*]* Revolcoat Almati[/*][*]* Alcinq Almati[/*][/list][/*][*]The 13-star Rarity Volgen weapon series has been added to the product list of the Exchange Shop under Equipment Upgrade II (Augment Transfer).[/*][*]Added new items to the Product List of the Exchange Shop under Purchase Build Parts.[/*][*]The Exchange Shop: SG Legacy Coordination Exchange has been renamed the Legacy Item Exchange.[/*][*]The item detail descriptions for the following items have been changed: [list][*]SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Hair)[/*][*]SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Pose)[/*][/list][*]Some items from the Super Origin Festival '25 SP Scratch lineup have been added to the Special Scratch.[/*][*]Added new items to the Card Scratch Ticket lineup.[/*][*]Changed the specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items are now available for exchange as Target Count Bonus Items: [list][*]MTN: Glide - Handy Propeller EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Handy Propeller EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Magic Incantation EX[/*][*]MTN: Idle - Magic Incantation EX[/*][*]MTN: Move - Giant EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Giant EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Lancer EX[/*][*]MTN: Idle - Lancer EX[/*][/list][/*][*]The icons for the following items have been changed.[list][*]C/Astrio S[/*][*]C/Endymio[/*][*]C/Hi Perio II[/*][*]C/Enhancement EXP +500,000[/*][/list]
[u]*The content and effects of these items remain unchanged.[/u][/*][/list][h2]Other specification changes[/h2]
[list][*]Added a new starter pack to the AC Shop containing a set of 15 Line Strike cards.
Cards included in starter packs can also be won from Card Scratch Tickets.
[u]*Please note that the cards included in the starter pack are not automatically registered to your deck, so you will need to register them by using the cards obtained after purchasing the set.[/u][/*][*]Added a support effect visual in Line Strike on the battle opponent’s side to clearly indicate when an opponent’s card has had its Attack power enhanced by the Vanguard Unit skill after being Overwritten.
During spectating and replays, this support effect visual will appear regardless of faction.[/*][*]Added an auto-focus feature for Line Strike spectating and replays to automatically switch the Card Details display according to the state of the match.[/*][*]Added a feature in Line Strike to display the Card List of your current deck during a match.
[u]*Assigned by default to the X key on the keyboard or to appear while pressing down the left stick on the controller.[/u][/*][*]Added card sleeves, play mats, and cards originally released on 6/4/2025 (Wed) (PDT) to NPC Victoria's Line Strike Card Recycle.[/*][*]In Line Strike, the English translation of the card title unlocked by CA: Wind 2 - Lumia and CA: Wind 2R - Lumia has been changed from "Heroic Sister" to "hero's sister" to better reflect the nuance of the original character.
Accordingly, the card "World's Fastest Hedgehog" will also reference the same card as Hero's Sister - Lumia instead of Heroic Sister - Lumia in English.[/*][*]Added a feature to let players toggle the "Look at the camera" option in Easy Photo Mode.[/*][*]Added more selectable Emotes to the Victory Performance Settings.[/*][*]A function to control the camera during skit playback has been added when accessing certain NPCs that appear after the Main Task: A Promise to Garoa.
[u]*For controllers: The camera can be operated using the R stick.[/u]
[u]*For keyboard & mouse: After clicking to advance the dialogue, you can drag before the next line appears to control the camera.[/u][/*][/list][h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

notes.content:
[b]Server maintenance planned date and time[/b]
[h3]From 7/29/2025 (Tue) 7:00 PM (PDT) to 7/30/2025 (Wed) 1:00 AM (PDT)[/h3]

[h2]Class Skill adjustments[/h2]
[list][*]Adjusted the visual cue of the counter window for the Braver Class Skill Fearless Attitude.[/*][/list][h2]Players[/h2]
[list][*]Adjusted Potency for special armaments when the player’s Battle Power is 4400 or greater.[/*][*]The following Preset Skills have been buffed:
[list][*]Fixa Attack: Increased Potency.[/*][*]Fixa Termina: Increased Critical Hit Potency.[/*][*]Fixa Fatale: Increased Critical Hit Rate.[/*][*]Fixa Wix: Increased Potency to Weak Points.[/*][*]Fixa Blastor: Increased Potency.[/*][*]Fixa Guard: Increased Damage Resistance.[/*][/list][/*][*]The EX Augments EX Enemy Down PP Gain and EX Enemy Down PP Gain II have been adjusted so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.[/*][/list][h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list][*]The following adjustments have been made to the Boss Enemies Renus Retem and Renus Vera.
[list][*]The screen-shake effect on some attacks has been reduced.[/*][*]The graphics for some attacks have been adjusted to make their attack range easier to see.[/*][*]The damage of some attacks has been reduced.[/*][/list][/*][*]Adjusted the Boss Enemy Elimineda so that during certain Downs, only player attacks to its weak point will connect.[/*][*]Reduced the damage of certain attacks of the Boss Enemies Elimineda and Destragras.[/*][/list][h2]Quests and Fields[/h2]
[list][*]Player visual effects will no longer display in certain quests, including Trainia and Drills.[/*][*]The amount of Points required to activate R Mag Boost [All] at Region Mags has been reduced.[/*][*]The Rare Drop indicator will now also display on Trial completion.[/*][*]Added a feature that allows players to check the details of Quest Rewards and Featured Item Drops from Quest Info.[/*][*]From the end of scheduled maintenance on 6/4/2025 (Wed) (PDT) until the start of scheduled maintenance on 6/17/2025 (Tue) (PDT), all Urgent Quests occurring in the Retem Region will be changed to the Urgent Quest: Shadow of the Fallen Star.
[u]*During this period, no other Urgent Quests will occur in the Retem Region. Please note that it will also not be possible to earn Titles related to other Urgent Quests in the Retem Region.[/u][/*][/list][h2]Interface[/h2]
[list][*]Added an Item Series search function to the Personal Shop search.
[u]*This function won't apply to items put up for sale before the update.[/u]
[u]*Only the Ektasis series and armors released in the future will be searchable.[/u][/*][*]Implemented the following improvements for the Wanted Item List:
[list][*]The Wanted Item List can now be accessed from the Personal tab in the Main Menu.[/*][*]Items from some Item Lists can now be added to the Wanted Item List.[/*][*]A "Wanted" icon will now display next to items registered to your Wanted Item List.[/*][*]EX Augments can now be added to the Wanted Item List.[/*][/list][u]*Selecting the item descriptions of the desired EX Augments displayed on the 3rd tab of the Item Details window will now display an "Add to Wanted Item List" menu.
You can register up to 3 combinations.[/u][/*][*]The following changes have been made to Auto Sell Drop Items.
[list][*]Added 11-to-13-star Rarity weapons to Auto Sell items.[/*][*]Added 11- and 12-star Rarity weapons to Auto Sell items.[/*][*]To accommodate these new additions, players can now freely switch between tabs for "Weapons," "Armor," and "Misc" that have been added to the menu.[/*][/list][/*][*]The size of the banner displayed in the AC/SG Shops has been adjusted.[/*][*]In Exchange Shops, item details now display when the player hovers their cursor over an item in the Target Item List.[/*][*]In Exchange Shops, an "Add to Wanted Item List" sub menu now displays when an item is selected from the Target Item List.[/*][*]The Item Trader Shop Menu now organizes items by tier within each category.[/*][*]Added a Camera Setting Values option to Camera Settings which displays Camera Setting Values in Easy Photo Mode.
[u]*Enabling this setting will display the Camera Setting Values in the controls UI while in photo mode.[/u][/*][*]The list order of tasks in the Limited-time tab of the Task List has been adjusted.[/*][*]The icon and thumbnail for Premium Sets now have a new design.[/*][/list][h2]Character Creation[/h2]
[list][*]Added the Face Option: Animatics Face to the default selectable list in Character Creation and the Salon.[/*][*]Added the following Face Base Types to the default selectable list in Character Creation and the Salon.
[list][*]Base Face 34[/*][*]Base Face 35[/*][*]Base Face 36[/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Items[/h2]

[list][*]C/Ultia Domina[/*][/list][/*][*]Some items from the Spring '25 Special Scratch lineup have been added to the Special Scratch.[/*][*]Added the following items to the product list in the Exchange Shop: ARKS Record Badge Exchange.

Cards included in starter packs can also be won from Card Scratch Tickets.
[u]*Cards included in starter packs are not automatically registered to a deck.

[list][*]Drop items have been added to the quest Leciel Exploration: Halpha Environmental Testing Zone Survey.[/*][*]Updated the animation prior to explosion of the Time Bomb Infernal used in Leciel Exploration: Halpha Environmental Testing Zone Survey, etc.[/*][*]Changed specifications for Nameless City Exploration: Nameless City Residential District Investigation to shorten the time during which no other trials occur before the Unlock Sign Collection Trial occurs.[/*][*]Changed the specifications of the Quest Menu at the Quest Counter as follows.[list][*]Newly added “Other” to the Quest Menu.[/*][*]Trigger Quests, Time Extension Quests, and The ARKS Chronicles have been moved to this new Other category.[/*][*]A new “Various Quests” quest type has been added under the Other category.[/*][/list][/*][*]Changed specifications so that Photon Chargesigne can be accessed while on board a special armament and while holding a throwable object.[/*][/list][h2]Interface[/h2]
[list][*]An explanation is now shown if the number of search results for Augment/Preset Skill Search under Item Search exceeds the limit.[/*][*]Up to 10 material items can now be selected for item enhancement.
[u]*Support items can be used as before.[/u][/*][*]The following specifications have been changed at the Item Trader.[list][*]Added a function to remove the New icon from items in the Top Menu when hovering on them, including from areas within those menu items.[/*][*]The New icon will now be shown when new items are added to the lineup.[/*][*]The New icon will now be shown above the heads of NPCs when they have new items in their lineup.[/*][/list][u]*When you log in for the first time, the New icon will be displayed for all products.[/u][/*][*]In the Free SG Scratch Ticket info window, the setting to prevent the window from opening has been removed and the specification has been changed so that the window is displayed in line with the others.[/*][*]Updated the Licenses displayed for the PC version and PS4 version of the game.[/*][*]Rarity of 12 or higher has been added to Rarity Settings for Item Drop Animations: Weapons/Armor in Options.[/*][/list][h2]Creative Space[/h2]
[list][*]Added new Storage to the Product List of the Purchase Build Parts section of the Creative Space menu.[/*][/list][h2]Items[/h2]

[list][*]In Line Strike NPC Battles, the decks used by characters at Beginner and Expert difficulties have been updated.[/*][*]The number of Card Scratch Vouchers you can earn from each Line Strike match has been updated as follows.[list][*]Unranked Battle: Victory: 12 vouchers/Loss: 4 vouchers/Draw: 6 vouchers[/*][*]Ranked Battle: Victory: 15 vouchers/Loss: 6 vouchers/Draw: 8 vouchers[/*][*]NPC Battle: Victory: 8 vouchers/Loss: 2 vouchers/Draw: 4 vouchers[/*][*]Free Battle: Victory: 4 vouchers/Loss: 4 vouchers/Draw: 4 vouchers[/*][/list][/*][*]In Line Strike, changed specifications so that it is no longer possible to select to Leave in the interval between the end of matchmaking and the start of the match.[/*][*]In Line Strike, changed specifications so that the chat window can be used while in a match.
However, you cannot use it to chat with Nearby Characters during Ranked Battles or Unranked Battles.[/*][*]In Line Strike, changed specifications so that the play screen is always reflected in screenshots taken during a match, regardless of the settings for UI Display When Taking Screenshots under Options → Graphics.[/*][*]Added Card Sleeves, Play Mats, and the cards released on 9/18/2024 (Wed) (PDT) to the NPC Victoria’s Recycle Line Strike Cards.[/*][*]Added two starter packs with 15 Line Strike cards each to the AC Shop.
Cards included in starter packs can also be won from Card Scratch Tickets.
[u]*Cards included in starter packs are not automatically registered to a deck.
After purchasing a set, you must register the newly acquired cards to the desired deck(s).[/u][/*][*]The names of some Augments have been changed as follows:
[u]*The effects of the Augments remain unchanged.[/u][list][*][b]Before change: [/b]Grand Dread Keeper LC[/*][*][b]After change: [/b]Grand Dread Keeper I LC[/*][/list][list][*][b]Before change: [/b]Grand Dread Keeper LCS[/*][*][b]After change: [/b]Grand Dread Keeper I LCS[/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]Confirmed issues[/h1]

[u]*With this bug fix, the participation requirements for the above two sectors will be changed to require a Battle Power of 3,981 or higher and the completion of Chapter 5 of the Main Story, An Update for Garoa.[/u][/*][*]Fixed a bug where, for some boss enemies, the special graphic would display when Garm Detonation was hit during reactions other than a down, even though the effect of Garm Beat Up was not applied[/*][*]Fixed a bug where Wandering Chests would sometimes temporarily not appear in Nameless City Exploration: Nameless City Residential District Investigation.

notes.content:

[h2][url=https://pso2.com/players/update/2024-06/][June Update Info][/url][/h2]

[h1]System updates[/h1]
[h2]Fighter adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Class Skill adjustments[/h3]
The following adjustments will be made to Fighter Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Overload[/td][td]Relaxed the Damage Taken Rate.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload Short Cycle[/td][td]Relaxed the Damage Taken Rate.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Defeat Advantage[/td][td]Change the specifications so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Defeat PP Recovery[/td][td]Change the specifications so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Attack Impact[/td][td]Adjusted to make it easier to attack the enemy’s Weak Points.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Acceleration Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Adjusted so movement will start immediately when activated on the ground.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Twin Daggers Quick Attack[/td][td]Change the specifications so that it can also be activated with Dagger Spin Counter.
Increased movement speed and distance when a target is present and not locked onto.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Spin Counter[/td][td]Increased movement distance.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Hitcount Up PP Gain[/td][td]Increased PP Recovery Amount.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spiral Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Changed specifications to allow movement in both vertical directions when activated while locked-on or in Over-the-Shoulder View, with a target present.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Saber Wind Amplify[/td][td]Increased the Charge Rate and Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Knuckle Attack Alternation[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3] Twin Daggers adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted attack effects.[/*][*]Increased Potency in the 3rd to 4th steps of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack.[/*][/list]
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Daggers Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Circling Buzzard[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Helzeus Coat[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased the motion speed after the attack cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pirouette Ripper[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Limber Figure[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Added omnidirectional guard points to the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3] Double Saber adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted attack effects.[/*][*]Adjusted the timing of whirlwind generation during the Double Saber Photon Blast.[/*][*]Increased the Charge amount for whirlwinds during the Double Saber Photon Blast.[/*][/list]
The following adjustments will be made to Double Saber Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Julien Dance[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased the rotation speed when the first half is activated.
Increased the movement speed in the first half when activated with a target present.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Unchained Circle[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Quick Gash[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sky Climb[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3] Knuckles adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted attack effects.[/*][*]Increased the Potency of the 4th to 5th steps of the Knuckles Normal Attack.[/*][/list]
The following adjustments will be made to Knuckles Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Swift Rush[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased the motion speed after the attack cancel timing in the first half.
Changed specifications to allow downward movement when the first half is activated in a locked-on or Over-the-Shoulder View with a target present.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thousand Blows[/td][td]Adjusted Potency distribution.
Expanded the attack range of some of the attacks in the second half.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.
Relaxed the attack cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Specifications changed to reduce the amount of altitude gained when activated in mid-air with no enemies nearby.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Double Drive[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Backhand Strike[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Adjustments made to increase the movement distance in the second half when activated from the first half.
Added omni-directional guard points to the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Players[/h2]
[list][*]The Potency of special armaments will be adjusted if the player’s Battle Power is 3900 or higher.[/*][/list]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list][*]Regular enemies of the same level as the Dread Enemies in the Stia Region will no longer spawn around them.[/*][/list]
[h2]Quests and Fields[/h2]
[list][*]The area where enemies appear during PSE Bursts has been narrowed in all Combat Sectors.
[u]*Excluding Combat Sectors where this area was already narrow.[/u][/*][*]After using a green jump pad, such as those found in Field Races, players' characters will now transition into a Dash Motion when landing on the ground while inputting a directional command.[/*][*]The spawn locations of some Dread Enemies in West Kvaris and Central Kvaris have been changed.[/*][*]In the following quests, quantities have been increased for some drop items:[list][*]Duel: Phase 1-1[/*][*]Duel: Phase 1-2[/*][*]Duel: Phase 1-3[/*][*]Duel: Phase 1-4[/*][*]Duel: Phase 2[/*][*]Duel: Phase 3[/*][*]Duel: Phase 4[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list][*]Updated Item Details so that the page last opened for items in a category is remembered until you exit the game.[/*][*]Added a setting for Vital Gauge Designs to toggle the display of the HP/PP gauges.[/*][*]Added the following menu items to the Quick Menu for Line Strike:[list][*]Line Strike Ranked Battle[/*][*]Line Strike Unranked Battle[/*][u]*These menu items will not be available for use until Line Strike is released in a later update.[/u][/list][*]Added backdrops to Edit ARKS ID that can be unlocked with Title Points.[/*][*]Added a With Augments item to the settings for Auto Sell Drop Items.[/*][*]Within Auto Sell Drop Items, if items are selected under Items That Can be Auto Sold, those items will now be sold automatically without regard to the Rarity levels, etc., selected in the options.[/*][*]Rarity of 11 or higher has been added to Rarity Settings for Item Drop Animations: Weapons/Armor.[/*][*]Changed specifications for Standard Sort under the Misc. tab of the Inventory so that items with expiration dates are displayed first in order to prevent them from being forgotten.[/*][*]Changed specifications so that the message is displayed when selecting a new notification for a new friend request, Alliance scouting, or mail during all All-ship Matchmaking.[/*][*]Added Premium slots 31 to 50 for Looks.[/*][*]Changed specifications for the Salon so that when the Advanced Settings of an accessory are restored to the default, the color of the accessory will be the color that the accessory has when it is worn.[/*][*]A new category, Line Strike, has been added to the Communication section of the Main Menu.
[u]*Line Strike is not currently playable. Please wait for a separate announcement on the start date.[/u][/*][*]Added an Augment Transfer menu option in the Item Lab.
[u]*See [url=https://pso2.com/players/news/sptransport/]here[/url] for details.[/u][/*][/list]
[h2]0Creative Space[/h2]
[list][*]Changed specifications for Premium and Rental Creative Spaces so that users can enter even after the Space’s expiration date.[u]*Players can only make edits while the Premium/Rental Creative Space is active.[/u][/*][*]Rental C-Space 04 has been added to Creative Space.[/*][*]Changes have been made so that it is easier to register Built Parts in succession.[/*][*]Changed specifications for Creative Space so that the reflection of light off of Built Parts appears more natural.
[u]*Brightness and color tones indoors may change as a result of this specification change.[/u][/*][/list]
[h2]Items[/h2]
[list][*]Changed specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items will be available for exchange as Target Count Bonus Items:[list][*]MTN: Glide - Leg Wheels EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Leg Wheels EX[/*][*]MTN: Glide - Graceful EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Graceful EX[/*][*]MTN: Glide - Dark Mage EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Dark Mage EX[/*][*]MTN: Glide - Star Riding EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Star Riding EX[/*][/list][/*][*]Changed specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items will be available for exchange as Target SG Scratch Items:[list][*]C/Highret Domina S[/*][*]C/Highkvar Domina S[/*][/list][/*][*]Added N-Augment Transfer Pass to the Product List in Item Recycle.[/*][*]A portion of the Spring '24 Special Scratch lineup has been added to the Special Scratch lineup.[/*][*]The following new items have been added to the Exchange Shop: ARKS Record Badge Exchange:[list][*]* Millenium Round Almati CV[/*][*]* Greaga Almati CV[/*][*]* Codeck Almati CV[/*][*]* Crystia Almati CV[/*][/list][/*][*]The following items have been added to the product list of the Exchange Shop: Giga Strugment Exchange:[list][*]C/Defi Eriss P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Ceires P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Plutos P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Makemes P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Haumeas P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Sednas P.04[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Other specification changes[/h2]
[list][*]Specifications have been changed so that Towers and Cocoons are changed to Discovered as each chapter of the Main Story is completed.[/*][*]A new Main Story will be released.
When you start the new storyline, releasing on 6/5/2024(Wed) 01:00 AM (PDT), any Mini Episodes that have not been viewed in Chapter 6 will have their status changed to viewed.
This is the perfect time to complete all the Mini Episodes if you haven’t already, so you can enjoy the new storyline even more.
[u]*Unwatched Mini Episodes that have their status set as viewed will still be accessible from the Quest Counter.[/u]
[u]*If you use an NGS Story Progress Ticket and start from Chapter 7 without having progressed through Chapter 6, the Side Tasks for Side Stories will be set as completed. Quest Rewards for Side Stories that have changed from uncompleted to completed can be earned by accepting orders from the Quest Counter and completing them.[/u][/*][/list]

notes.title: 5/29 End of scheduled maintenance announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2161124d611237262b728ea66ac59d9b2823ffa9.png[/img]
The version number on the bottom right of the screen is now Ver.7.2601.3.

Please see the following link for more details on this update.
https://pso2.com/players/news/update20240529/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QWxNsjsM330

[h2]Confirmed issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug where some graphics of the Basewear Monotone Dress [Ba] and its color variations are not displayed correctly under certain conditions
[*]A bug where some graphics are not displayed correctly for the accessory GGM-99 Missile Launcher R and its color variations[/list]
We are working to fix the above issues in a future update.
We apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience as we work to correct these bugs.

[hr][/hr][h2]Maintenance details[/h2]
[h3]Things addressed during maintenance[/h3]
[list][*]Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-7, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, Mission Pass Storage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.
[i]*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.[/i]
[*]Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.
[i]*Ship transfers during scheduled maintenance are processed in the order that they are received. There is a limit to the number of transfers that can be performed during each maintenance, and if the maximum number of applications is reached, applications will be rolled over to the next scheduled maintenance.[/i]
[i]*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check [url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/gamestart/ship/]here[/url].[/i]
When logging into PSO2 Blocks, each character’s location will be set to the Gate Area.
[i]*Characters may be moved to the Bridge depending on their progress in the story or if it is the first time the character is being used.[/i][/list]

[hr][/hr][h2]Items sent to Receive Campaign items[/h2]
Please check the official website page for more information.
https://pso2.com/players/news/i_maintenance_20240529/

[i]*You can obtain delivered items via the Receive Campaign Items option on the Visiphone in PSO2 Blocks or Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Items are distributed to the account, so please be mindful of which character you use to receive them.
*You will not be able to receive items if you do not have enough space in your inventory or if additional items would exceed your maximum carrying capacity.[/i]


Thank you for playing PSO2 New Genesis!

In PSO2 Blocks [b]on the 1st and 21st of every month[/b] – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the [b]ARKS Rappy[/b] will appear! They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!
They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a [b]Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS[/b]!

[i]*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]Only users using a Premium Set during the campaign period are eligible.
[*]The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
[*]The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]
Thank you for enjoying PSO2:NGS!

notes.title: Premium User PSO2 Day!
notes.content:
[h3]Check the link [url=https://pso2.com/players/schedule/]here [/url]to see an overview of new and ongoing events and campaigns![/h3]

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/651efdac5f80dce3b44dfebb6b8c54bab8cf3dbf.jpg[/img]
[h1]Premium User PSO2 Day![/h1]

The 21st of every month is PSO2 DAY for Premium Set users!
We’ll also have Limited-time Tasks that everyone can enjoy, so take this chance to make the most of NGS!

[i]*This campaign will be held for 48 hours, as there is a scheduled maintenance set to be conducted during the campaign period. Please be aware that the normal duration for this campaign is 36 hours.

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Campaign Period[/h2]
[b]8/21/2023 (Mon) 5:00 PM (PDT) - 8/23/2023 (Wed) 5:00 PM (PDT)[/b]

[hr][/hr][h2]Campaign information[/h2]

[table]  [tr]    [td]NGS Blocks[/td]    [td][b]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/b]
[list][*]EXP Earned +20%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +50%
[/list][i]*For quests with fixed rewards, only the EXP Earned +20% boost will be applied.

*Leciel Exploration is not eligible for the Rare Drop Rate Up Campaign Boost Effect. However, the Rare Drop Rate Up Boost Item Effect is applied.[/i]

[b]Limited-Time Tasks (All players)[/b]
[list][*]PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks
[/list][i]*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.[/i][/td]  [/tr][/table]

[table]  [tr]    [td]PSO2 Blocks[/td]    [td][b]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/b]
[list][*]FUN +100%
[*]EXP Earned +200%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +200%
[*]Gathering Fever Occurrence Rate +100%
[/list][i]*The amount of FUN points earned by consuming items that give you FUN points are not eligible for the FUN +100% Boost effect.[/i]

[b]Boost Event (All players)[/b]
[list][*]Item Enhancement Success Rate +10% (Units/Skill Rings)
[*]Augmentation Success Rate +15% (Weapons/Units)
[*]Enhancement EXP +15% when enhancing a weapon[/list][/td]  [/tr][/table]

[hr][/hr][h2]Gifts in NGS Blocks[/h2]
[list][*]50 SG
[i]*When you receive Star Gems via the Receive Campaign Items menu, they will be directly added to your owned Star Gems (SG).[/i]
[*]Special Scratch Ticket (x2)[/list]
[i]*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.

*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.

*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.

*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.

*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them..[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]The ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day![/h2]

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]    [th]                             ARKS Rappy[/th]    [th]                          Rappy Suit Mini[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/img][/td]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/img][/td]  [/tr][/table]

In PSO2 Blocks [b]on the 1st and 21st of every month[/b] – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the [b]ARKS Rappy[/b] will appear! They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!
They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a [b]Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS[/b]!

[i]*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the "Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties" box. After accepting the quest, select "Party Commands" under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]Only users using a Premium Set during the campaign period are eligible.

[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
[*]The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]
Thank you for enjoying PSO2:NGS ver.2!

notes.title: The 1st of every month is PSO2 Day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/02d9cab1ddb018b2ec7a060a1d103005cc5d99f6.jpg[/img]
Enjoy PSO2 Day on the 1st of every month!
There will be Limited-time Tasks, so come and enjoy NGS during this period!

[i]*This campaign will be held for 48 hours, as there is a scheduled maintenance set to be conducted during the campaign period. Please be aware that the normal duration for this campaign is 36 hours.

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.[/i]
[hr][/hr][h2]Campaign Period[/h2]

[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [td]ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ8/1/23 (Sun) 5:00 PM (PDT) - 8/3/23 (Tue) 5:00 PM (PDT)[/td]  [/tr][/table]
[hr][/hr][h2]Campaign information[/h2]

[table]  [tr]    [td]NGS Blocks[/td]    [td][b]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/b]
EXP Earned +20%
Rare Drop Rate +50%

[i]*For quests with fixed rewards, only the EXP Earned +20% boost will be applied.[/i]

[b]Limited-Time Tasks (All players)[/b]
PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks

[i]*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.[/i][/td]  [/tr][/table]

[table]  [tr]    [td]PSO2 Blocks[/td]    [td][b]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/b]
FUN +100%
EXP Earned +200%
Rare Drop Rate +200%
Gathering Fever Occurrence Rate +100%

[i]*The amount of FUN points earned by consuming items that give you FUN points are not eligible for the FUN +100% Boost effect.
[/i]
[b]Boost Event (All players)[/b]
Item Enhancement Success Rate +10%
(Units/Skill Rings)
Augmentation Success Rate +15%
(Weapons/Units)
Enhancement EXP +15% when enhancing a weapon[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[hr][/hr][h2]Gifts in NGS Blocks[/h2]
[list][*]50 SG

[i]*When you receive Star Gems via the Receive Campaign Items menu, they will be directly added to your owned Star Gems (SG).[/i]

[*]Special Scratch Ticket (x2)[/list]
[i]*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them..[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]The ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day![/h2]

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]    [th]                             ARKS Rappy[/th]    [th]                          Rappy Suit Mini[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/img][/td]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/img][/td]  [/tr][/table]

In PSO2 Blocks [b]on the 1st and 21st of every month[/b] – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the [b]ARKS Rappy[/b] will appear! They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!
They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a [b]Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS[/b]!

[i]*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]Only users using a Premium Set during the campaign period are eligible.
[*]The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
[*]The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]
Thank you for enjoying PSO2:NGS!

notes.title: Schedule change for 6/6 maintenance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f8f6cf6a48482ff8a4b109601e025bfc9b2535e4.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you for playing PSO2 NEW GENESIS.

The date and time for the scheduled maintenance on 6/6 (Tue) (PDT) will be changed as follows:[/b]

[h3]6/6 (Tue) 3:00 PM (PDT) to 6/7 (Wed) 1:00 AM (PDT)[/h3]

[hr][/hr]
*You will not be able to log in to the game server during this period.

*Please do not connect to the game servers until the end of maintenance is announced.

*Please note that the availability of Weekly Tasks and Limited-time Tasks that end at 8:00 PM (PDT) on the day of scheduled maintenance will end at the start of scheduled maintenance.

*Please note that if the 24 hour period after a Character Deletion Request passes during the maintenance, the character will be deleted.

*Characters that have completed the “Application for Ship Transfer During Scheduled Maintenance” will be transferred. AC will not be consumed until the Ship Transfer is complete.

*Ship Transfer applications will be processed according to the order in which they were submitted. However, some Ship Transfers may be postponed until the next Scheduled Maintenance if the number of submitted applications is excessive.

*If you do not have enough AC at the beginning of the Scheduled Maintenance, Ship Transfer will not occur, even if you purchase AC during the Scheduled Maintenance.

*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check [b][url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/gamestart/ship/]here[/url][/b].

[hr][/hr]
[b]Please note that the scheduled maintenance end time may change depending on the circumstances.[/b]

Please also be aware that along with the time change for the scheduled maintenance on 6/6 (Tue) (PDT), distributed items with a receipt period that is until the start of scheduled maintenance must be received by [b]6/6 (Tue) 3:00 PM (PDT)[/b].

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Events and Campaigns
notes.content:
[h3]Check the link [url=https://pso2.com/players/schedule/]here [/url]to see an overview of new and ongoing events and campaigns![/h3]

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/651efdac5f80dce3b44dfebb6b8c54bab8cf3dbf.jpg[/img]
[h1]Premium User PSO2 Day![/h1]

The 21st of every month is PSO2 DAY for Premium Set users!
We’ll also have Limited-time Tasks that everyone can enjoy, so take this chance to make the most of NGS!

[i]*This campaign will be held for 48 hours, as there is a scheduled maintenance set to be conducted during the campaign period. Please be aware that the normal duration for this campaign is 36 hours.

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Campaign Period[/h2]
[b]5/21/2023 (Sun) 5:00 PM (PDT) - 5/23/2023 (Tue) 5:00 AM (PDT)[/b]

[hr][/hr][h2]Campaign information[/h2]

[table]  [tr]    [td]NGS Blocks[/td]    [td][b]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/b]
EXP Earned +20%
Rare Drop Rate +50%
*For quests with fixed rewards, only the EXP Earned +20% boost will be applied.

[b]Limited-Time Tasks (All players)[/b]
PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks
*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[table]  [tr]    [td]PSO2 Blocks[/td]    [td][b]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/b]
FUN +100%
EXP Earned +200%
Rare Drop Rate +200%
Gathering Fever Occurrence Rate +100%
*The amount of FUN points earned by consuming items that give you FUN points are not eligible for the FUN +100% Boost effect.

[b]Boost Event (All players)[/b]
Item Enhancement Success Rate +10%
(Units/Skill Rings)
Augmentation Success Rate +15%
(Weapons/Units)
Enhancement EXP +15% when enhancing a weapon[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[hr][/hr][h2]Gifts in NGS Blocks[/h2]
[list][*]50 SG

[i]*When you receive Star Gems via the Receive Campaign Items menu, they will be directly added to your owned Star Gems (SG).[/i]

[*]Special Scratch Ticket (x2)[/list]
[i]*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them..[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]The ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day![/h2]

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]    [th]                             ARKS Rappy[/th]    [th]                          Rappy Suit Mini[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/img][/td]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/img][/td]  [/tr][/table]

In PSO2 Blocks [b]on the 1st and 21st of every month[/b] – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the [b]ARKS Rappy[/b] will appear! They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!
They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a [b]Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS[/b]!

[i]*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]Only users using a Premium Set during the campaign period are eligible.
[*]The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
[*]The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]
Thank you for enjoying PSO2:NGS!

notes.title: Advanced notice of the release of paid Level and Story Boost features
notes.content:
[h3]We are planning to provide paid features in the update on 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) that enable players to raise their class levels or advance their Story Progress instantly.
[/h3]

The purpose of these features is to support those who are just starting or returning to the game and want to catch up to and socialize with other players as well as access new content.
Moreover, we believe it will also help players who wish to level additional characters progress though the Main Story in a more efficient manner.

See below for preliminary introductions to each new feature.

[hr][/hr][h3]NGS Story Progress Tickets[/h3]
This item can be used to skip through the Main Story to the latest chapter at the time of use.
[list][*]The selected Main Class at the time of item use will get the EXP needed to reach the recommended class level to play the latest chapter.
[*]Purchase limit: none[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]Class Level 70 & Equipment Set[/h3]
This item raises the selected Main Class level to 70 and provides one weapon from each weapon category available to the selected class as well as 3 pieces of armor.
[list][*]Equipment items will be set to increase the character’s Battle Power to the amount they need to play the latest content as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT).
[*]Purchase limit: 1 for each class on each character.
[*]Items will be delivered to the OP Team Storage.[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]NGS Ver.1 All Trainia Explored[/h3]
This item sets the status of all Cocoons and Towers available as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) to “completed” so that players can acquire the Skill Points from the first clear reward.
[list][*]If there are Cocoons or Towers you’ve already completed, you will not receive the first clear reward Skill Points again.
[*]Purchase limit: 1 per account.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We will provide further details at a later date.

Thank you for enjoying PSO2 NEW GENESIS.

[b]Limited-Time Tasks (All players)[/b]
PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/61bc7804764be21a334eae1eb17556005b11d19e.jpg[/img]

[i]*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them..[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]The ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day![/h2]

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]    [th]                             ARKS Rappy[/th]    [th]                          Rappy Suit Mini[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/img][/td]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/img][/td]  [/tr][/table]

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear! They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!
They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

[i]*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]Only users using a Premium Set during the campaign period are eligible.
[*]The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.

[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]
Thank you for enjoying PSO2:NGS!

[h2]Confirmed Issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug with entering search words into the Wanted Item List where, if the upper/lower case letters do not match those in the official item name, the item is not displayed
[*]A bug with the Aegis Integra Exchange in the Item Trader where, when exchanging the Exchange Item: Aegis Integra and selecting items that exceed the Allowed Exchanges under Items to Exchange, the selected item(s) and the item(s) listed in the exchange confirmation screen do not match
[i]*The exchange will be successful if the selection condition of the Allowed Exchanges and the Items to Exchange match. If it does not, the exchange will fail and the Items to Exchange will not be consumed.

[i]*In conjunction with this fix, the specifications will be changed so that the effect is also applied during the period between the activation of the Harmonizer Weapon Action and the start of the charge.[/i]

notes.title: New Year's greeting, 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d05c06a8d98b448fbd2e21d7dea5b08361c2a7a0.jpg[/img]
[h3]Happy New Year![/h3]

Thank you very much for enjoying PSO2 and PSO2 NEW GENESIS (NGS) during the past year.
Please allow us to offer our deepest appreciation.

The year 2022 was a memorable year that marked the first anniversary of NGS and the 10th anniversary of PSO2.

We delivered two major updates in NGS last year, releasing the Kvaris region in June and the Stia region in December. Moreover, we launched the PS4 version for Global in August, and even more players worldwide joined NGS as ARKS Defenders.

We held various offline events outside of the game in addition to the 10th Anniversary Project, such as ARKS EXPO 2022 at Tokyo Big Sight, NGS Kizuna Café at Tokyo Solamachi, and an exhibition as part of AX 2022 in North America.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all of you who have supported us over the past 10 years.

This year also marks the 35th anniversary of the Phantasy Star series. We are holding [b]Sympathy 2023 on 1/20/2023 (Fri) (PST)[/b] to celebrate the 10th anniversary of PSO2 and the 35th anniversary of the PSO series. It will be our first orchestral concert in almost two years. Most of the music from NGS will be performed for the first time. We hope that those who attend the event will be able to experience the spectacular live performance, and those who cannot make it to the venue will be able to enjoy the music of the Phantasy Star series and NGS through our [u]global live streaming[/u].

Going back to the NGS game, following the Stia region that you have been enjoying, the final battle awaits ARKS Defenders with Dark Falz coming back in February. We hope that you will be there to witness what ARKS will learn about the secrets of planet Halpha.

There is more to come in April and May: new [i]classes[/i], new stories, and the NGS 2nd anniversary event. And in June, Creative Space is scheduled to be released under the title (tentative): Ultra Evolution Update.

We received a great deal of positive feedback on the content we previously shared regarding Creative Space, which has been a great encouragement to our Live Operations and Development Team.
We are sorry to keep you waiting a little longer, however, we will take your comments into consideration and work together to develop and deliver the content in better quality.

All of our team members will make every effort to ensure that everyone continues to enjoy the game.
We hope you have a great year with PSO2 NEW GENESIS!

-PSO2 New Genesis Live Operations and Development Team

[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 12/13/2022 (Tue) 6:00 PM (PST) ended on 12/14/2022 (Wed) 12:00 AM (PST).

Discussion is underway for an appropriate compensation and we will announce the details at a later date.

notes.title: 12-7 End of Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcdb5696c8ec2b8d1c0504521218ceddd516c02f.jpg[/img]
[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 12/6/2022 (Tue) 3:00 PM (PST) ended on 12/7/2022 (Wed) 12:00 AM (PST).

The version number on the bottom right of the screen is now Ver.7.0901.0. Please see the following link for more details on this update.[/h3]

[b][url=https://pso2.com/players/news/update20221207/]12/7 Update Details[/url][/b]

[h2]Confirmed Issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug with the “Cocoon King” Title Tasks where if all Side Missions are not completed and cleared on the first attempt, the task will not progress - even if all Side Missions are completed and cleared on the second or subsequent attempts

[i]*We have confirmed that logging off and on again should allow you to progress should this issue occur.[/i]

[*]A bug where the Innerwear Color synchronization text is not displayed for the following Setwear and Outerwear:

Skelstelth/B [Se]
Skelstelth/B2 [Se]
Mountain Parka T1/B [Ou]
Mountain Parka T1/B2 [Ou]
Skelitors/B [Se]
Skelitors/B2 [Se]
Mountain Parka T2/B [Ou]
Mountain Parka T2/B2 [Ou]

[*]A bug with Battledia: Yellow: Stia Troopers which causes a gap or gaps to appear in part of the terrain
[*]A bug with the Xbox One version where some of the screen display is distorted when certain rare enemies spawn if the Screen Space Reflection graphics setting is turned on

[i]*We have confirmed that if this bug occurs, it can be temporarily improved by turning off Screen Space Reflection in the graphics settings. We hope this will be helpful to those experiencing this bug. (Updated: 12/09/2022 12:20 PM (PST))[/i]

[*]A bug where the cost of the following Motion Changes is set to 3:

MTN: Glide - Mini Glider 2
MTN: Glide - Mini Glider/B

[i]*The correct cost is 2.[/i]

[*]A bug in Cannonball Rumble and Cannonball Strike where the display at the start of a Wave is the display for the Geometric Labyrinth[/list]
We are working to fix these issues in a future update.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience while we resolve these issues.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Issues fixed in NGS[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed a bug with the Twin Machine Guns’ Sidestep Counters where, under certain conditions, the number of hits could be reduced
[*]Fixed a bug with some active Class Skills where attacks could be activated even when a weapon other than the corresponding weapon was equipped
[*]Fixed a bug with the Jet Boots Photon Blast where an attack released under certain conditions could disappear without moving
[*]Fixed a bug with the Talis Photon Art Spread Shot where the Talis would not deploy under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug with the Harmonizer Photon Art Wulfen Demolition where the charge state could not be released when the Waker Class Skill Hot Marmelo Parry was used while charging
[*]Fixed a bug with the Techter Class Skill Wand Element Change where a quest may start with an Element added under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug with the Techter Class Skill Wand Element Change where the changed Element was not carried over when advancing to the next floor in Trinitas: Geometric Labyrinth
[*]Fixed a bug with the Techter Class Skill Wand Element Revoke where under certain conditions, the Element discard effect could be triggered even if the button was not held down
[*]Fixed a bug with the Waker Class Skill Lucky Sign where the effect may not be activated at the start of the quest
[*]Fixed a bug with the Waker Class Skills Linear Drive and Linear Drive Encore that prevented players from moving and attacking when activated under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug in which the Main Class correction was not applied to the Waker Class Skill Familiar Harmony when a Multi-weapon was equipped
[*]Fixed a bug in which the Main Class adjustment was not applied to the Bouncer Class Skill Jetsweep Jolt when a Multi-weapon was equipped
[*]Fixed a bug with the Braver Class Skill Brave Combat Final Bonus in which the recovery effect could be activated multiple times under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug with incorrect effects being displayed when attacking with Launchers equipped with the * Nightblossom Varie Weapon Camo
[*]Fixed a bug with the Recycler Unit Potentials in which the effect was either always activated or always deactivated under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug with the effects of the Citadel Unit and Gyrating Unit Potentials disappearing when advancing to the next floor of Trinitas: Geometric Labyrinth
[*]Fixed a bug with the descriptions of the Impervious Unit Potentials where the Damage Resistance effect was described as low

[i]*Only the descriptions of the Potentials have been modified. There is no change in the effect that is triggered.[/i]

[*]Fixed a bug with the Recycler Unit Potentials where the effect may not be activated when moving to a Field or a Cocoon
[*]Fixed a bug with boss enemies Eldi Scythe and Svadi Scythe where some attacks could hit the player multiple times
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, boss enemies Crocodylis and Crocodylis Vera sometimes could not be downed
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, some attacks from boss enemy Relyn did not hit players
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, some attacks from boss enemy Vardias did not hit players
[*]Fixed a bug where boss enemies Nogleth and Sand Nogleth did not perform certain actions when discovering the player
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, some attacks from boss enemies Ams Kvaris and Ams Vera did not hit players
[*]Fixed a bug where Dread Enemies were sometimes not displayed correctly in West Kvaris and South Kvaris

[i]*Due to this fix, the positions of the Veteran Frostyl Sword and Veteran Pangolan have changed.[/i]

[*]Addressed a bug in which the weak points of some enemies are sometimes buried in the terrain when they are downed
[*]Fixed a bug where TAMES did not move when pushed by an enemy
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, lock-on was canceled when Character Direction 2 was set as the Lock-on Target Priority Setting
[*]Fixed a bug in the Urgent Quest Mining Rig Defense: Kvaris where the Barrage Wall Barrigale appeared longer on the radar map than it actually was
[*]Fixed a bug where some enemies did not appear correctly in the Belugana Ruins Combat Sector Tundra Enemy Suppression
[*]Fixed a bug with the Urgent Quest: Mining Rig Defense and the Transport Truck Defense Trial where healing actions by the enemies Proctys Ael and Proctys Retem repaired structural damage to the defense base
[*]Fixed a bug where PSE Burst Task Markers did not appear when moving to a Sector where a PSE Burst was actively occurring
[*]Fixed a bug where the Radar Map did not return to the map’s default zoom after completion of the Urgent Quest: Mining Rig Defense
[*]Fixed a bug where the scores for Fastest Clear Time and Most Score Symbols sometimes did not update in Field Races
[*]Fixed a bug where some effects were displayed incorrectly on the PS4 version
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, incorrect Weekly Tasks were sometimes released
[*]Fixed a bug in the Title Tasks: ARKS ID Snoop I, II, and III where sometimes actions other than viewing ARKS IDs were counted for the task
[*]Fixed a bug where certain Boost Effects were sometimes not displayed in the Current Effects section of Stat Information
[*]Fixed a bug with Alliance Task Records where a notification was not displayed when a member application mail was sent to a currently recruiting alliance
[*]Fixed a bug with Add-on Skills that, under certain conditions, sometimes caused players to be unable to proceed after registering an Add-on Skill
[*]Fixed a bug with the Party Settings Menu and Party Settings in Party Commands under Quests where the input information was sometimes not deleted even if the player left the party or the party was disbanded
[*]Fixed a bug where the location of party members in the same Room was not displayed in Gather Party Members
[*]Fixed a bug with the Room Keyword/Photo Room Settings where, when the Party Leader changed the Room Keyword, the Room Keywords of Party Members in other Rooms were also changed
[*]Fixed a bug with Gather Party Members where a different Room Keyword was reflected to party members when they joined the Keyword Room where the Party Leader was present
[*]Fixed a bug with Gather Party Members where new notifications of gathering requests received during event playback were no longer displayed after being viewed
[*]Fixed a bug with Party Boost where the Effect values of Current Effects were not displayed to the first decimal place
[*]Fixed a bug with Equipment Information for other characters where color information was displayed for Outfits that did not support Color Settings
[*]Fixed a bug with the Sector Info for Exploration Sectors of the World Map where, when acquiring a Convert-to-Cash item for the first time, it was not recorded in the Gathering Explored: percentage if it was set to Auto Sell in Auto Sell Drop Items

notes.title: Premium User PSO2 Day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/651efdac5f80dce3b44dfebb6b8c54bab8cf3dbf.jpg[/img]

The 21st of every month is PSO2 DAY for Premium Set users! We’ll also have Limited-time Tasks that everyone can enjoy, so take this chance to make the most of NGS!

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.

[h2]Campaign Period[/h2]
11/21/2022 (Mon) 4:00 PM (PST) - 11/23/2022 (Wed) 4:00 PM (PST)

[h2]Campaign Information[/h2]
[h3]NGS Blocks Content	[/h3]
[i]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/i][list]
[*]EXP Earned +20%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +50%[/list]*For quests with fixed rewards, only the EXP Earned +20% boost will be applied.

[i]Limited-Time Tasks (All players)[/i][list]
[*]PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks[/list]*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.

[h3]PSO2 Blocks Content	[/h3]
[i]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/i][list]
[*]FUN +100%
[*]EXP Earned +200%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +200%
[*]Gathering Fever Occurrence Rate +100%[/list]*The amount of FUN points earned by consuming items that give you FUN points are not eligible for the FUN +100% Boost effect.

[i]Boost Event (All players)[/i][list]
[*]Item Enhancement Success Rate +10%
(Units/Skill Rings)
[*]Augmentation Success Rate +15%
(Weapons/Units)
[*]Enhancement EXP +15% when enhancing a weapon[/list]
[h2]NGS Blocks Gift Introduction item[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/61bc7804764be21a334eae1eb17556005b11d19e.jpg[/img]

*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them.

[h2]ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/img]

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear!

They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!

They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.

[h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
[*]The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]

[b]For more information on current campaigns, check [url=https://pso2.com/players/schedule/]this [/url]page![/b]
