notes.title: Premium User PSO2 Day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/651efdac5f80dce3b44dfebb6b8c54bab8cf3dbf.jpg[/img]

The 21st of every month is PSO2 DAY for Premium Set users! We’ll also have Limited-time Tasks that everyone can enjoy, so take this chance to make the most of NGS!

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.

[h2]Campaign Period[/h2]
10/21/2022 (Fri) 5:00 PM (PDT) - 10/23/2022 (Sun) 5:00 AM (PDT)

[h2]Campaign Information[/h2]
[h3]NGS Blocks Content	[/h3]
[i]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/i][list]
[*]EXP Earned +20%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +50%[/list]*For quests with fixed rewards, only the EXP Earned +20% boost will be applied.

[i]Limited-Time Tasks (All players)[/i][list]
[*]PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks[/list]*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.

[h3]PSO2 Blocks Content	[/h3]
[i]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/i][list]
[*]FUN +100%
[*]EXP Earned +200%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +200%
[*]Gathering Fever Occurrence Rate +100%[/list]*The amount of FUN points earned by consuming items that give you FUN points are not eligible for the FUN +100% Boost effect.

[i]Boost Event (All players)[/i][list]
[*]Item Enhancement Success Rate +10%
(Units/Skill Rings)
[*]Augmentation Success Rate +15%
(Weapons/Units)
[*]Enhancement EXP +15% when enhancing a weapon[/list]
[h2]NGS Blocks Gift Introduction item[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/61bc7804764be21a334eae1eb17556005b11d19e.jpg[/img]

*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them.

[h2]ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/img]

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear!

They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!

They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.

[h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
[*]The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]

[b]For more information on current campaigns, check [url=https://pso2.com/players/schedule/]this [/url]page![/b]

notes.title: Premium User PSO2 Day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/651efdac5f80dce3b44dfebb6b8c54bab8cf3dbf.jpg[/img]

The 21st of every month is PSO2 DAY for Premium Set users! We’ll also have Limited-time Tasks that everyone can enjoy, so take this chance to make the most of NGS!

*Please also note that you will receive the gifts only once during the period.

[h2]Campaign Period[/h2]
9/21/2022 (Wed) 5:00 PM (PDT) - 9/23/2022 (Fri) 5:00 AM (PDT)

[h2]Campaign Information[/h2]
[h3]NGS Blocks Content	[/h3]
[i]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/i][list]
[*]EXP Earned +20%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +50%[/list]*For quests with fixed rewards, only the EXP Earned +20% boost will be applied.

[i]Limited-Time Tasks (All players)[/i][list]
[*]PSO2 Day Limited-Time Tasks[/list]*For more information, please go to the in-game main menu Tasks/Quests, select Tasks, and check the Limited Time Tasks.

[h3]PSO2 Blocks Content	[/h3]
[i]Boost Event (Only for players with an active Premium Set)[/i][list]
[*]FUN +100%
[*]EXP Earned +200%
[*]Rare Drop Rate +200%
[*]Gathering Fever Occurrence Rate +100%[/list]*The amount of FUN points earned by consuming items that give you FUN points are not eligible for the FUN +100% Boost effect.

[i]Boost Event (All players)[/i][list]
[*]Item Enhancement Success Rate +10%
(Units/Skill Rings)
[*]Augmentation Success Rate +15%
(Weapons/Units)
[*]Enhancement EXP +15% when enhancing a weapon[/list]
[h2]NGS Blocks Gift Introduction item[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/61bc7804764be21a334eae1eb17556005b11d19e.jpg[/img]

*To be eligible for gifts, it is necessary to select a character and enter an NGS Block.
*If you start using a Premium Set during the event period, the gift item will be sent once you move to an NGS Block.
*Please refer to the Receive Campaign Items menu in-game for the deadline to receive campaign items.
*You can obtain gifts via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be careful about which character you use to receive them.

[h2]ARKS Rappy can be found in PSO2 Blocks during PSO2 Day![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6a58ec4e1cd7fb8093030f49c2f417eeed518f72.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c3f4662fd8b43406793d33996c89c8f60959230f.jpg[/img]

In PSO2 Blocks on the 1st and 21st of every month – known as PSO2 Day – an ARKS style Rappy called the ARKS Rappy will appear!

They look so cute wearing their version of the Close Quarters outfit!

They might drop equipment with new Augments or even a Rappy Suit Mini: ARKS!

*The ARKS Rappy only appears in new Rooms created after the campaign starts. A new Room can be created by accepting a quest, setting a password, and then checking the Also Limit Multiplayer Requests from Other Parties box. After accepting the quest, select Party Commands under Community in the Main Menu, and change the Password Settings under Party Settings to allow other players to join.

[h2]Precautions[/h2]
[list][*]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.
[*]The account may no longer be eligible to receive the gift if all characters that met the requirements are deleted.
[*]In PSO2 Blocks, to prevent server overload, some notifications, such as incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will not be displayed if you log in during an Urgent Quest. Even though the notification is not displayed, incoming mail, Alliance invitations, and campaign items will be delivered normally.
[*]The ARKS Rappy does not appear in Trigger Quests.
[*]The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/list]

[b]For more information on current campaigns, check [url=https://pso2.com/players/schedule/]this [/url]page![/b]

notes.title: BRAVER CLASS: INFORMATION AND CLASS SKILLS
notes.content:
Braver is now here in PSO2 New Genesis!
Braver can use two weapon types (Bow and Katana), perfect for both close and long-ranged combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/17c7c6347da32f43a03c102e6cdee15f1295bd7c.jpg[/img]

To get started with Braver you can do so at the Class Counter! 
Be sure to expand the class selection box under Techer so that it's viewable for selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcd35acc5f739dc23a8aeb802a2b5637a1cafc08.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1ce9184bb9f0c0900e992f19837bcb525afdc998.jpg[/img]

[h2]Braver Class Skills[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8aadd9fea2629e2f057167cc3a9174e9b632cf2a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d657b84bc59164a5a88f9d9486a37657ae4a8bdf.jpg[/img]

[b]•Brave Combat (Active Skill/For Braver Weapons Only)[/b]
Reduces PP consumption and increases attack PP recovery for a fixed time. Using the skill again while already activated will launch a powerful attack. 

[b]•Resta Effect Amplifier[/b]
Increases HP recovery amount when you use Restasigne.

[b]•Katana Guard Counter Advanced (Katana Only)[/b]
Adds a shockwave to the Counter when performing a Perfect Guard with Weapon Action.

[b]•Bow Elusion Plus (Bow Only)[/b]
Using a Weapon Action while pressing the directional pad at just the right time after releasing a Photon Art will make you slide while attacking.

[h2]Braver Photon Arts[/h2]

[b]•Silverleaf Storm[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/21a4b6c9cac7fee699724aaf9aed59718086f840.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2eb2a06fa6658efcc37bbefff12df201647d9ff8.jpg[/img]

Katana Photon Art. Releases a forward slash after a swift sword draw. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

[b]•Iris Gale[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8e004585c173a0dbf3cdd4124913dcb27b66a86d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fba8a6dd1297ec60590527f1e0e070c661fa618c.jpg[/img]

Katana Photon Art. Mows down nearby enemies after a swift sword draw. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

[b]•Lotus Lightning[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/391ebfde3c270da6bda24ddcb2f7ad0c57f010cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/490d976c8b1659844f76704f73e4e72b3b2832e1.jpg[/img]

Katana Photon Art. Releases manifold shockwaves in a straight line after charging your sword. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

•Flex Arrow
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ce33696b282c130a73eb12c979dea4fa31c3d031.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fd7025f4a54016c09509942fb7d6eb73d024bd64.jpg[/img]

Bow Photon Art. Fires homing arrows. Can be charged up to two power levels to release different attacks.

[b]•Frenzied Firework[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1bfe125832209b7dd5e70475a10f2adf6346e4cd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/99bcdf6b4dd4752d7580abd9fd373ef400bb0db0.jpg[/img]

Bow Photon Art. Scatters arrows all around when you hit an enemy. Charge to launch an alternate attack.

[b]•Dimensional Ray[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/00a1bd3c9c8c41f820c40e30dcbad604f5c9d440.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/95a376f7fa3e2d0db677e7184e6ebcfd4242b6dd.jpg[/img]

Bow Photon Attack. A bow from an alternate dimension rains arrows on enemies. Charging will cause the bow to teleport and release homing attacks when you land hits with other Photon Arts. 

[h2]Braver Instructor Deirdre![/h2]
[b]•New Side Task! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ada2df196a35ce4f63fd8631dce9873cf92d4e1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0f6371e14c68e578abe36b18ce7f30ff3395947e.jpg[/img]

Deirdre is the newly-assigned Braver Instructor for ARKS. She’s an 18-year old Deuman, the same age as Ran. “Braver Basic Training” is a task in which ARKS Instructor Deirdre teaches the basic fighting method for the Braver class in a practical manner. Try out this task if you want to give the Braver class a try! 

[b]New Weapon Categories![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2eace5465a916a6082e5b0fabfb2ad538a49d58a.jpg[/img]

New Katana and Bow weapon categories have been added! The Katana has been added to the 4-star rarity Foursis weapon series, and the Bow has been added to the Vialto series! Weapons of 3-star rarity or less have also been added to other weapons series, such as Trois De and Theseus series, so be sure to get them!

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: Wedding Celebration

notes.title: Regarding Improvements Underway to Reduce Lag During Peak Hours

We have confirmed that following the PSO2 NEW GENESIS launch, the increased load on servers during peak hours has been causing some parts of the game to lag.

We have identified part of the cause of this problem, and are taking measures to improve the situation. Emergency Maintenance will be conducted as soon as the preparations are complete. 

We will update everyone again regarding the expected date and time for the Emergency Maintenance once the details have been finalized.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.



- The NGS Team

[b]If you’re a fan of FRAME ARMS and FRAME ARMS GIRL, be sure to check out this newest AC Scratch Ticket collection released on December 23rd! Read on for a sneak peek![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2f646022ded20dbcf82207e83f7785209cc1b8b3.jpg[/img]

If you’ve ever wanted to dress up as your favorite FRAME ARMS or FRAME ARMS GIRL, now you can with the AC Scratch Ticket collection [u]FRAME ARMS RELOADED[/u], coming on December 23rd! Get fully equipped with accessories and items inspired by FRAME ARMS, such as the [b]120mm Low-recoil Gun[/b] or the [b]Evolution Device: BASELARD G![/b]

[previewyoutube=7ikvS5D7qaI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: HOLIDAY WONDERLAND
notes.content:
[b]It’s (almost) the most wonderful time of the year, Arks, and this AC Scratch and FUN Scratch ticket collections are proof! Check out what you can get, starting on December 15th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fe0e15d03ea1ba640ed1c5bb41a0e50a987db391.jpg[/img]

You operatives have been good, really good, and so ARKS HQ is sparing the coal and spoiling you with some great fashion! The [u]HOLIDAY WONDERLAND[/u] AC Scratch Ticket collection will have you clamoring for some hot apple cider and peanut brittle while you’re decked out in cozily warm clothing! Check out the [u]MERRY CAROLING DRESS[/u] for female operatives or snag your own [u]* JINGLE TREE[/u] Weapon Camo! Be sure to make your list and check it twice, because Arks deserve great fashion, naughty or nice!

[previewyoutube=XMp1M9Ig5MM;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!


[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 12/15 11:00 PM (PST)
[b]Ends:[/b] 01/12 10:00 PM (PST)

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: ULTIMATE TRINITY
notes.content:
[b]Celebrate the launch of Episode 6 with some ARKS-inspired fashion! Coming on December 8th, the new AC Collection Ultimate Trinity and Part 1 of the FUN Scratch Ticket Collection for December will be out of this world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c2d515332df8cf7704f51464407e0956576c44b4.jpg[/img]

If you’re looking for some new battle-wear, trust the ARKS pros and go with the styles in this new AC Scratch Collection, [u]ULTIMATE TRINITY[/u]! Your ARKS Commander always has efficiency on her mind, and her wardrobe shows it, so adopt her style for your own with the [b]Full-dress Deputy[/b] or [b]Full-dress Commander[/b] layering pieces! Alternatively, you can shine brightly in [b]Esta Teresa[/b] pieces or fade into the shadows in your own set of [b]Scharf Vinto[/b] items! In any case, be sure to check out this collection, coming on [b]December 8th![/b]

[previewyoutube=IZmj5ul60ns;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!


[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 12/08 (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 01/05 10:00 PM (PST)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC
[u]*Release date and time are subject to change due to server maintenance.[/u]

notes.title: AN ARKS HOLIDAY EVENT!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Holidays, Arks! Check out how Fleet Oracle will be spreading the holiday cheer by examining this article![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f22f49e0a7ffce53b938d0da2d64df035b184d75.jpg[/img]

Every day Arks have something to celebrate, whether it be the eradication of an enemy or the fulfillment of a Client Order. Ultimately these tasks are about helping – or protecting – others, and that theme is featured strongly in the holiday season as well! ARKS HQ has wrapped quite a present for you this holiday season, so read on and we’ll unwrap it together!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ceb2996c0b8c822bfcc451d77127c67271ecc15b.png[/img]
[h2][b]QUNA’S HOLIDAY SPIRIT[/b][/h2]
Quna is feeling merry so she’s putting on performances of Eternal Encore with a holiday twist to them! Be sure to catch this special concert in the Shopping Plaza so you can experience the wintry magic with your fellow ARKS Operatives!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/9aa7a5f47defd3bce0baed11edd8cae8d152cc72.png[/img]
[h2][b]HOLIDAY DÉCOR [/b][/h2]
[b]Begins:[/b] 12/08 (PST) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/31 11:59 PM (PST)

The trees have been lit, and piles of snow abound in the Shopping Plaza. You know what to do, Arks! That’s right, build a snowman! The stockings have even been hung in the Gate Area! With so much festive cheer, you’re bound to get in the holiday spirit!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c8e2b0067e473e410a30c73ab26449f1730eded3.png[/img]
[h2][b]CHRISTMAS ON ICE[/b][/h2]
[b]Begins:[/b] 12/08 (PST) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/31 11:59 PM (PST)

In the snowy and normally silent Tundra area of Naverius, things are beginning to stir. Decorations have been placed, lights have been lit, and all await the pending festivities with glee. However, there are others that have also been attracted by the hubbub, and they are not on the guest list. Falspawn and other enemies are circling, attracted by the lights and music, and sadly they are not your average opponents. Resonant and other enhanced enemies have been spotted, and it’s up to you, ARKS Operatives, to ensure that our Holiday Venue remains safe for guests. 

In [b]groups of 12,[/b] you’ll have just [b]10 minutes[/b] to clear the rabble from the Venue, and [b]Quest Points[/b] will be allotted to those who make the largest dent in the number of invaders. Naturally, as more enemies are defeated, the more intelligent and ferocious enemies will assume the defenders to have flagging spirits and will make their move; so be on your guard as your time nears its end. 

Fortunately, these enemies appear to have quite the collection of rare weapons and equipment on them, so their extermination may be to your personal benefit as well.

notes.title: WHAT’S NEW IN EPISODE 6
notes.content:
[b]There’s a LOT of content coming when Episode 6 boards the Ship, operatives! Check out this article and study up so you’re prepared!
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/74295eeaa1a81419ca44d6f3b034e943376e11fb.jpg[/img]

So, you left the Sacred Magical Kingdom of Epykuento in the transcendent hands of a friend, and headed back to Fleet Oracle for some much needed R&R. The only problem is that your legendary feats in vanquishing one enemy inadvertently permitted the entry of another – and she even had the gall to thank you for it. As your experience on Alternate Dimension: Omega taught you, the universe tends to favor recycling things; though chaos often interferes and these re-creations can be – flawed. Add this to the newfound knowledge that your experience on Omega may not have been historically accurate, and you have the recipe for a grim sense of foreboding. ARKS will again need your help; to make sense of the past – and preserve the future.


There will be new training regimens, and new equipment that will better enable Fleet Oracle to meet this new challenge head-on when it arrives. Apprise yourselves of the contents of this notice, operatives, and then dispose of it in a secure manner.


[h2][u][b]WHAT’S NEW[/b][/u][/h2]

Some of the new changes and features include:

[list]
[*] New Story
[*] Player Level cap increased to 95
[*] New Classes – Phantom & Étoile
[*] New Summoner Pets – Herbie and Vulcan
[*] New Urgent Quests
[*] New Quest Type – Risk Exploration
[*] Arms Extension
[*] New Quest Difficulty – Ultra-Hard (UH)
[*] New ARKS Missions
[*] New Rising Weapons Badge
[*] New Enemy Type – Luminmech and Ultra Enemies
[*] New Seasonal Events
[*] New Mission Pass Season
[*] Exciting new Titles to earn
[*] Additional Recommended Quest – Level Up Quest
[*] New Collection Folders – Legendary 15★ Collection Folder, 14★ Eggs Collection 1
[*] New Bonus Quest – Special Mission: Tokyo [Rainbow]
[*] New Practice Quests – Étoile, Phantom, AIS Vega
[*] New S-Grade Augments
[*] New 15★ Weapons at Zig Shop
[*] New 13★ Units at Zig Shop
[*] 13★ Units can be have S-class Augments - S6, S7, S8
[/list]
 

A few of the new features and changes deserve to have a little bit more said about them, so let’s get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a24401cdca52abdfde9f658fde868505e37c48e8.png[/img]

[b]NEW STORY[/b]

After your victorious return from the battle in Alternate Dimension: Omega, the universe seems to be righting itself, as the massive Black Hole seems to have disappeared. The only remaining oddity left to address is the sudden appearance of someone bearing a striking resemblance to a recent acquaintance – who happens to call herself Shiva, Goddess of Annihilation. Outside of the forbidding name, perhaps most alarming is the fact that Photon Arts and Techniques appear to be totally ineffective at warding her, and her companions, off. Fortunately, her initial overture towards ARKS was brief, though its purpose was to flatly declare war.

Bolstered by an armada of her own, Shiva has deployed her forces in a standard formation – directly opposing Fleet Oracle. Though the battlespace is limitless, preparation time is not, and the most massive battle in the history of ARKS is about to begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/67964f7324b39da2b8ecd587a24a27a60b49fe53.png[/img]

[h2][b]SCION CLASS - PHANTOM[/b][/h2]

A Scion Class, the Phantom adeptly uses Rods, Katanas, and Assault Rifles in a manner unique to their Class. But their advantage doesn’t end there, for they can quickly modify their Rod or Katana’s standard Photon Arts on the fly with the use of a Weapon Action, thus executing a [b]Shift Photon Art[/b] and increasing the variety of attacks they can perform. Even their Techniques, when executed with a Rod in hand, provide an additional [b]Technique Attack[/b].  


In the hands of a Phantom, the Phantom Assault Rifle is used to create [b]Phantom Bits[/b], allowing the Phantom to continue with their Attacks and Photon Arts while deployed Bits seek and detonate upon the target. Perhaps most impressive, subsequent attacks against enemies will apply a [b]Phantom Marker[/b], which detonates when struck with a Charged Weapon Action.

 
Finally, Phantoms can learn the skill [b]Phantom Time[/b], which extends the duration of their invulnerability when sidestepping and reduces their PP consumption by 20% for a short time. Using [b]Phantom Time Finish[/b] once the duration of Phantom Time is nearly expired will unleash a massive attack upon the Phantom’s enemies. As with all Scion Classes, you will need to level two Classes to level 75 before you are able to complete Officer Kofy’s Class Permit Trial unlocking the Phantom Class. Phantoms are also unable to select a Sub-Class, however other Classes can select Phantom as their Sub-Class.

[b]Notable Photon Arts of the Phantom include:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Rufkonzert[/b] - Rod Photon Art for Phantoms. Unleash a string of attacks and then let loose a shockwave. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
[*] [b]Wolkenkratzer[/b] - Katana Photon Art for Phantoms. Execute a drop attack accompanied by a shock wave. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
[*] [b]Verbrechen[/b] - Assault Rifle Photon Art for Phantoms. Launch a line of attack satellites as you move. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/898352ecffddc1fcd87d187f9d97494d8425a2cd.png[/img]

[h2][b]SCION CLASS - ÉTOILE[/b][/h2]

Notable in the fields of Defense and Support skills, Étoiles shine quite brightly when in the thick of battle. Capable of wielding the Double Saber, which allows for increased aerial mobility; Soaring Blades, which grant them the ability to defend while still attacking; and Wands, which provide free movement while allowing the Étoile to continue with their attacks.
 

In the hands of an Étoile, the Double Saber grants the operative high mobility, special aerial abilities, and the ability to accumulate Focus through the Focus Gauge – which is spent automatically to help mitigate incoming damage. Naturally, this Focus can also be spent on an [b]Enhanced Attack[/b], so it’s up to the Étoile to determine the best use of their Focus at a given time. The Weapon Action of the Étoile Double Saber is called [b]Deflect[/b] and using it will activate a [b]Perfect Guard[/b]. Deflect can also be used to unleash a powerful counterattack. Perhaps most notable is the Étoile’s ability to use [b]Double Saber Skip Arts[/b], allowing them to tailor their attacks to specific parts of their Photon Arts.


Soaring Blades allow an Étoile to [b]Parry[/b] by using their Weapon Action. This allows them to block attacks from every direction, even when the Étoile is in the middle of a Photon Art. Étoile Soaring Blades also allow the use of the Focus Gauge, which can be spent on a powerful [b]Connect Attack[/b] upon reaching a certain level. Building the Focus Gauge even more will unleash a [b]Full Connect Attack[/b].


Perhaps the most favored weapon, the Étoile Wand provides the operative with high mobility and attacks that chain together naturally. Using the Weapon Action at the right time during the use of a Photon Art will release a [b]Focused Photon Art[/b], which may be smaller in scope, but far more powerful. Used on its own, the Weapon Action will activate [b]Charge Protect[/b], providing the Étoile with defense while moving. By expending the Étoile Focus Gauge, this defensive stance can be maintained longer. Once the Focus Gauge has been depleted to a certain level, a powerful attack known as a [b]Protect Release[/b] will occur and devastate the area surrounding the Étoile.
 

Naturally, as with the other Scion Classes, this Class is restricted to senior operatives who have reached Level 75 with two different Classes. Also, like the Phantom, Étoile can be chosen as a Sub-class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/898352ecffddc1fcd87d187f9d97494d8425a2cd.png[/img]

[b]Notable Photon Arts of the Scion include:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Light Wave[/b] – Soaring Blades Photon Art. Unleashes a barrage of blows that emit shockwaves and launches a Photon Blade that pierces the enemy.
[*][b] Black Hole Rapture[/b] – Wand Étoile Photon Art. Sucks up targets into an explosion. Attack changes depending on Weapon Actions.
[*] [b]Celestial Collide[/b] – Double Saber Photon Art. Release a giant Photon Blade into the enemy with a heel drop.
[/list]

[h2][b]NEW SUMMONER PETS – HERBIE AND VULCAN[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/7bb38bc5d64558f209c977287e50e6359055a34c.png[/img]

[u][b]Herbie[/b][/u] – An evolved form of Redran (though of the same Rarity), Herbie has increased DEX (+93 at Level 130). Herbie has a new personality type, that of GENIUS. When facing a Boss-type enemy, this personality will provide [b]increased PP recovery[/b], faster performance of Photon Arts, and increased Normal Attack damage[/b]. Though evolved from Redran, Herbie’s Photon Arts are slightly different in that [b]Laser[/b] affects fewer targets, the potency and range of [b]Mine[/b] are increased in exchange for a higher PP Cost, Slash yields higher damage at the cost of more PP, [b]Gravity[/b] requires less PP, and [b]Burst[/b] charges faster and requires less PP but also deals less damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b72473de6f6e54b24eb6ea406c6a47bdcab238fe.png[/img]

[u][b]Vulcan[/b][/u] – The evolved form of Synchro, its nature allows for higher damage with chained Photon Arts. It has an altered personality, however, and is considered [b]Aggressive[/b]. This personality reduces its Critical Hit Rate in exchange for greatly increased damage. It also has slightly [b]higher Dexterity, Defense, and HP[/b] than its lesser form. [b]Kick’s [/b]damage is greatly increased at the cost of more PP, [b]Fist[/b] deals increased damage, and [b]Bomb[/b] and [b]Strike[/b] do more damage compared to their Synchro counterparts.

[h2][b]NEW RECOMMENDED QUESTS – LEVEL UP QUESTS[/b][/h2]

There’s a new entry in the Recommended Quests at the Quest Counter – Level Up Quests! These will also reward a Special Present at the end of the Quest, in addition to providing an additional 200% EXP!

 
[h2][b]NEW COLLECTION FOLDERS[/b][/h2]

Earn your way towards your next upgrade!


[b]Legendary 15★ Collection Folder[/b]

That’s right Arks! Check out these [b]15★, +30 Enhancement Level Weapons![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fb0f644ddb0b2e3ff2543ff205c00f7948041b18.png[/img]


[u][b]14★ Eggs Collection 1[/b][/u]

Summoners, we heard you! Don’t miss this opportunity to earn a 14★ Pet Egg of your choosing!

[h2][b]NEW ENEMY TYPES – LUMINMECH AND ULTRA HARD[/b][/h2]

Naturally, Shiva has some new baddies for operatives to play with. See below for the latest information ARKS HQ has received on them!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/52e68aaa72c5e2bcd777a250816f20e4bdab5734.png[/img]

[u][b]Luminmech[/b][/u]

Luminmech are enemies created and dispatched by Shiva, Goddess of Annhilation. Luminmech have high attack power, use heavy armor, and have unique skills that make them a very dangerous foe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0ae3514d732c2a0bfba4a361c3c71a301ffc48ea.png[/img]

[u][b]Ultra Enemies[/b][/u]

Ultra Enemies are Native inhabitants and Falspawn of each planet that have undergone an additional, corruption-induced transformation. These enemies will be encountered in [b]Ultra Hard Difficulty Quests[/b].

After dispatching some Ultra Enemies, operatives have reported that each has dropped a special [b]15★[/b] weapon, similar to those dropped in Risk Exploration quests.

[h2][b]NEW QUEST TYPE – RISK EXPLORATION[/b][/h2]

Expeditions may have become less challenging as you’ve become more powerful, but that doesn’t mean there aren’t enemies out there that will truly test your mettle! Risk Explorations are the next frontier that ARKS HQ would like you to explore, but be forewarned, because these quests are only available for those who aren’t afraid to take on Ultra Hard Quests!

It takes some time (3 days) for ARKS HQ to plan out which set of areas should be explored, and when, so these will not all be simultaneously be available, as normal Expedition Quests are. You can also expect to be more challenged by the random occurrence of Emergency Trials as well, as they’ll have more difficult goals under different conditions than those that have occurred elsewhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/784e3bdea513e04314315104980e3caf4fde2c02.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c026e1417559ca38f7a75bdfdb3e2fdbfe411108.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW ZIG SHOP ITEM – KEY RIVALATE WEAPON SERIES[/b][/h2]

You can now exchange weapons for 15★ RIVALATE SERIES WEAPONS at the Zig Shop, provided you have the necessary materials, including a [b]Key Rivalate[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/279f316e9140d1aad4e8068e691e3b7670f29a26.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/99d6d69ea8e4e06d967652070753ff6bf468833c.png[/img]


[h2][b]WEAPON EXTENSION AND 13★ WEAPON CREATION[/b][/h2]

That weapon seemed perfect when you first got it, but now compared to some of the new items you’re picking up lately, it’s not so hot. The good news is that WEAPON EXTENSION Is now available in your Personal Quarters via the Crafting Terminal! Extending your (up to 12★) weapon can overwrite the standard stats with those of a selected recipe – once you’ve raised the weapon’s [b]Extension Level[/b] enough – with the maximum level being 12. The Enhancement Level, Augments, and Weapon Potentials will not be affected.


To Extend your weapon, you’ll need some materials, most of which can be attained by [b]Dismantling 7★ or higher equipment[/b] at the Crafting Terminal. As you Extend more items, you’ll attain Crafting Achievements, which will unlock additional, more powerful Recipes.


If you’re looking for an entirely new upgrade and the Rare Drop Rate has not favored you, you can now [b]craft 13★ weapons[/b] at the Crafting Terminal! These weapons can then be Extended up to Extension Level 8!

[h2][b]RISING WEAPONS BADGE 5[/b][/h2]

The next Rising Weapons Badge, and the wares that can be purchased with them, are here! Perhaps most notably, you can now purchase Sweets for your Pets and S-Grade Augments!

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: CORRUPTED HEROES
notes.content:
[b]It’s a harsh galaxy out there operative, and you should be prepared. Embrace the theme of survival and check out the AC Scratch Ticket collection Corrupted Heroes, coming November 24th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d7fc3d4c3072099082418c5a45a6dca26694a622.jpg[/img]

With the content of Episode 6 coming up, it’s a good idea for operatives to be prepared for diverse environments. That’s why the gear in this next AC Scratch Collection, [u]CORRUPTED HEROES[/u] includes masks that’ll have you breathing safely no matter what vapors assault your senses. The style of the pieces is also geared towards survival, featuring tough edges and hard-wearing materials. So if you’re looking for some new pieces for Episode 6, be sure to check out this collection when it becomes available on [b]November 24th![/b]

[previewyoutube=eUvqkfneCyQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!


[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 11/24 11:00 PM (PST)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/29 10:00 PM (PST)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: BLAZING BEATS
notes.content:
[b]Join the Sacred Order of Holy Knights with the newest AC Scratch, Blazing Beats, with tickets arriving at a Scratch Ticket Terminal near you on November 18th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/9bd714f75a2bdda0a323fd16f1198d668ad69752.jpg[/img]

Gears may not be the same as Falspawn, but they also threaten mankind. ARKS could possibly learn a thing or two from the members of the Sacred Order of Holy Knights, or at the very least, appreciate their fashion! Get a grip on their style by checking out the AC Scratch Collection, [u]BLAZING BEATS[/u], coming your way on [b]November 18th![/b]

[previewyoutube=fnq3jVItN20;full][/previewyoutube]
There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets


[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the [b]Blazing Beats[/b] collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 11/18 12:00 AM (PST)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/15 11:00 PM (PST)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC
[u]*Release date and time are subject to change due to server maintenance.[/u]

notes.content:
[b]Operatives are multi-talented, with some of them creating some amazing designs. Check them out in this AC Scratch Ticket, Designer Dreams II![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/86c4bc188f76358669ef50a43eab4d7a29818034.jpg[/img]

ARKS Operatives aren’t always on a mission, in fact, they have quite a bit of free time to themselves. Some of them choose to spend it in a creative way, perhaps dreaming up whimsical clothing and accessories to delight their fellow operatives with. ARKS HQ is happy to announce that some more of those designs caught our attention, and we’d like to share them with you in the newest AC Scratch Ticket collection, [i]DESIGNER DREAMS II[/i]. These pieces have various themes to them, but all can be described as “whimsical,” so they’re sure to delight. See them for yourself when they become available from your nearest Scratch Ticket Terminal on [b]November 10th![/b]

[previewyoutube=yOo544SGasg;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!


[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 11/10 11:00 PM (PST)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/08 10:00 PM (PST)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC
[i]*Release date and time are subject to change due to server maintenance.[/i]

notes.title: THANKSGIVING IN PSO2!
notes.content:
[b]It’s Turkey-time! Prepare yourselves (and your stomachs) for the Thanksgiving Event, coming November 11th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/85293638ba73925d92d3715799a7394c363e7734.jpg[/img]

Happy Thanksgiving, Arks! It is time to show our gratitude for those who fight to protect others, and naturally that includes operatives. The Ship has been decorated, special treats will be offered, and new holiday-themed items are available! Without further ado, let’s get into the content of the [i]THANKSGIVING EVENT[/i], starting [b]November 11th[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a5795f29497925a95619c8960145d724041098db.png[/img]
[h2][b]A CORNUCOPIA OF DECORATIONS![/b][/h2]
If you’re hungry for Thanksgiving décor, then you’re sure to be stuffed after visiting the Shopping Plaza of your Ship. ARKS HQ has really flown the coop with the Thanksgiving theme, and Rappy takes center stage (though in this case he’d probably prefer not to.) Oh, and the Medical Bay would like to remind operatives to not eat any of the display items, regardless of how good they look. 

[b]Begins:[/b] 11/11 (PST) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/08 (PST) (beginning of maintenance)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0998a792251a6f5af79ae50b28930c2f00f4ac9c.png[/img]
[h2][b]A FESTIVE (AND WELL-TIMED) GATHERING OF WINGED ONES[/b] [/h2]
A situation has arisen where winged creatures and Falspawn are gathering en masse on the Floating Continent of Amduskia. Little do they know, this is not the best time to be encouraging an ARKS hunt, as Xia has quite a few mouths to feed for her upcoming feast. It may be a good idea to stop by and visit her in the Shopping Plaza before heading to the Gateway ship to take on this quest. Operatives are to head to the Floating Continent and determine the reason this flock is gathering. You’ll have 30 minutes to complete your investigation, and each enemy defeated will reward you not only with combat experience, but with points, with 1126 Quest Points being required for quest completion. 

Due to the somewhat uneven terrain, ARKS HQ has deployed a few [b]Catapults[/b] and [b]Dash Panels[/b] that we had left over from the Summer training event. When at a Dash Panel, pressing “E” will temporarily enable high-speed movement to cross terrain. Touching another Dash Panel will extend the effect. You can jump or kick while under the effects of the Dash Panel, and the kick can be powered up 3 times by chaining the use of Dash Panels. Catapults will send you soaring in the direction indicated. Be sure to explore every inch, as some Catapults may take you to otherwise unreachable areas! So get out there and pluck some feathers so you can get your [i]* TURKEY LEG[/i] weapon camo, which works for all weapons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/530b0d2ef014d8f53b50a6fb10a97490ac1d7294.png[/img]

[h3][b]Featured Rewards[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]LIMITED-TIME ARKS MISSIONS[/b][/h2]
In the process of completing campaigns or gathering materials, don’t forget to take a look at your [i]ARKS MISSIONS[/i] List every now and then, but especially for this event. ARKS HQ has added a few extra objectives for operatives to complete, and the rewards range from some [b]Roasted Turkey[/b] to [b]Thanksgiving Badge 2020[/b], which can be used to purchase items from Xia’s special shop. If you need a refresher on ARKS Missions, check out [url=https://pso2.com/news/blogs/arksmissions]this[/url] article.


[h3][b]ADDITIONAL CONTENT COMING NOVEMBER 11TH![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a13ccf0e928710014c2910dd0af21308488e5369.png[/img]
[h2][b]SURVEYING A PARALLEL WORLD[/b][/h2]
Perhaps the most extreme Ultimate Quest that any operative can undertake, [i]SURVEY: REMNANTS OF A PARALLEL WORLD[/i] is not for the faint of heart. Only senior-ranking Arks (those above level 80 on both Main and Sub – Class) should attempt this mission, as it is to be done solo. That’s right, on your own, as the area is too unstable to allow for greater numbers of operatives. Your supplies will be limited such that Scape Dolls or Half Scape Dolls won’t save you. When the 15 minute time limit is up, or should an operative become incapacitated, participants will be extracted and the quest will be considered a failure. You’ll have 10 attempts at this quest each day, with the counter resetting at 5:00 AM (PST). A successful quest still consumes one attempt. Remaining, unused attempts do not transfer over to the next day.

Your mission briefing is fairly simple. Leadership has received signals coming from this specific sector of Alternate Dimension: Omega, and their magnitude indicate that the entity responsible is equal to the strength of the Profound Darkness. Initial probes have shown that the area is layered, with a stronger enemy present on each successive level. You will not be able to traverse the levels freely though, as defeating the prime enemy on a level will result in an ARKS extraction for a medical evaluation, mandated by HQ.


[h2][b]Powerful Augments[/b][/h2]
The energy of the sector seems to have influenced the items available to those who explore it, and some cursory explorations have yielded the following.

[h3][b] Available Augments[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6e01c6dee9ec9b03c0b76dfa7c1e3cfba4473aba.png[/img]

[h3][b]Featured Rewards[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c4caf1c00cec998ed7ca07210301b8562c8d2240.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/4976b0d6f2b80c7080c2e463412c9f28ed9edf62.png[/img][/url]
Back / Mask of Vane | ★12, Unit


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/4eea09b63691dc083e27a48a9040913d2ca1e1d2.png[/img]
[h2][b]PHANTASY STAR UNIVERSE(S)[/b][/h2]
Ethan and Karen have taken their interplanetary patrolling to another world, and that’s not just a saying – they really did – since they wound up on Fleet Oracle. They’re going to need some assistance in finding a way back to their world, and so far they have no idea where to start looking. As they’re unfamiliar with the hazards of the ARKS sphere of influence, they’re going to need an escort, and you’re just the operative to do it! Not only will you have the pleasure of their company (permanently, as you can receive their [b]Partner Cards[/b]), but you may also wind up with some weapon camos too! Check out what you’ll receive by completing their [b]Client Orders[/b]!

[h3][b]Featured Rewards
[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/05da8d9ee9936168a05772931e7b50cfa6809b9c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f8acd72c1eec159b5cd8ce2d600bab06d83ee309.png[/img][/url]
* Giant Slicer  | Weapon Camo

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/48f6db8f3a1c122bec6d901d1c4c8c5ea8e7f1f0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/e528ac874785262e60683ede281f8211b8787afe.png[/img][/url]
* Crea Doubles | Weapon Camo

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/5ae18eb35cba3ac0726a29fc557b652db2a0e448.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/91c6852a7ee1f9fd02f478632eaea69650720c83.png[/img][/url]
* Dagger of Seraphi | Weapon Camo


[h2][b]★15 STAR WEAPON EXCHANGE[/b][/h2]
That’s right, they’re here – well, at Zig’s Shop actually. ARKS HQ is proud to announce the availability of 3 types of [b]★[/b]15 weapons; the [i]OPHISTIA SERIES[/i], the [i]TRAILBLAZER XION SERIES[/i], and the [i]ATLAS EX SERIES[/i]. In order to acquire one of these weapons, you have a short list of materials to procure, though some of the items may require an upgrade of their own. After all, in order to get something, you have to give something, and in this case it’s a template from which Zig can work. Each series requires the submission of one (or more) [b]★[/b]14 weapons from specific weapon series that are enhanced to [b]+35 Enhancement Level[/b]. These Enhancement Levels were not achieved in vain, however, as the resulting [b]★[/b]15 weapon will retain them. For more information on the specifics of [b]★[/b]15 weapon exchange at the Zig Shop, check out [url=https://pso2.com/news/announcements/star15weapons]this[/url] article.

We hope you’re as excited as we are to share the Thanksgiving spirt! So pass the Volcanic Caves Pumpkin pie and dig in!

 

- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: PROUD MONARCH
notes.content:
[b]When you’re divine royalty, it’s important that you look your best. The regal looks of the Divine Queen of Epyk have inspired this next AC Scratch ticket, Proud Monarch; arriving on November 3rd![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/969499db30aff298b7795669807493f553b0b2d6.jpg[/img]

In contrast with the silk, velvet, and leather present in the Weyland Warriors collection, the new AC Scratch ticket collection [i]PROUD MONARCH[/i] features airy fabrics and gilding that are sure to have everyone believing the wearer to be royal. In addition, this collection contains a few pieces that are inspired by certain important figures in Fleet Oracle. So, whether you’re a queen or king, or if you’d like to pay homage to your favorite operative, be sure to check out [b]Proud Monarch[/b], available [b]November 3rd![/b]

[previewyoutube=_UuqrXI1n3c;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!


[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from this collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 11/03 11:00 PM (PST)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/01 10:00 PM (PST)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: WEYLAND WARRIORS
notes.content:
[b]You’ve proved you’re no pansy, but your wardrobe could probably use some more durable layering pieces. Fortunately, the new AC Scratch Weyland Warriors will be invading Scratch Ticket Terminals near you on October 28th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/08fe12f92443746965f6eb4f8c22cf164af7c69b.jpg[/img]

With a motto like “Death to the weak, life to the strong,” it’s necessary that the clothing used by the people of Weyland bear up under hard use. That’s why ARKS HQ thought it would be a great idea to introduce it to ARKS Operatives, in the next AC Scratch collection [i]WEYLAND WARRIORS[/i]! The country that likes to fight, just for the sake of fighting, has produced some durable leather layering pieces that’ll have you covered in inclement weather as well as protect you from abrasions received on the field of battle. Once you’re ready to get cleaned up, check out the more detailed pieces with feathers and embroidery – which are sure to make you stand out from the crowd. So if you like what you see, grab a spot at a Scratch Ticket Terminal near you on [b]October 28th[/b]! 

[previewyoutube=DIc3i_gBch0;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!

notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: DARK ABYSS
notes.content:
[b]Need a costume for a Spook-tacular party? Check out the AC Scratch collection Dark Abyss, available on October 14th! Sneak-peak available here![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/535dd0e964e598efbc94cab2f12c85d63c51a23d.jpg[/img]

Who’s ready for the spookiest AC Collection to debut in 2020? ARKS HQ is happy to announce that the AC Scratch Ticket collection, [i]DARK ABYSS[/i], will be available beginning [b]October 14th[/b]! We know you’ll love these Halloween-themed designs styled for some of your favorite PSO2 characters. Alongside this AC Scratch Ticket collection comes Part 2 of the FUN Scratch lineup for October! So make sure to Moon some Incapacitated Operatives (the PSO2 version, of course) and spend your FUN Points on tickets to get the items below!

[previewyoutube=NJv6AhDFsU8;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!

[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the [b]Dark Abyss[/b] collection!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN IN PSO2!
notes.content:
[b]“Boo!” to you, from PSO2! We didn’t want Arks going Personal Quarters door to Personal Quarters door and possibly disturbing tired operatives, so we figured we’d throw our own Halloween Event![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/7861e62b5ca2e74a9be79e96b761cb085c9ab779.jpg[/img]

Welcome to a Phantasy Star Halloween, Arks! After visiting Earth during previous quests, ARKS has decided to celebrate a beloved holiday of the inhabitants of Earth, which led to the [i]HALLOWEEN EVENT[/i]! There’ll be candy-themed weapons and other fun things to find and explore. The new Urgent Quest [i]TRICK OR TREAT[/i]!, the introduction of the Expedition [i]BEWITCHED WOODS[/i], costumed Rappys and Emperappys, decked-out Xia, and more, await operatives of Fleet Oracle! Check out the individual sections below to learn more about each facet of the Halloween Event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/89ca85539ce02632dcaee49aa32c17e1c8355394.png[/img]

[h2][b]DÉCOR THEME: SPOOK-TOBER![/b][/h2]
Your ship’s Gateway Area has been decked out in Halloween-themed decorations, so that operatives are kept in the Halloween-spirit while dancing, showing off costumes, and of course, accepting Quests from the Quest Counter. For those who spend more time in the Shopping Plaza, pumpkins and autumnal-themed items have been put on display. Please refrain from carving any pumpkins, however. 

[b]Begins:[/b] 10/13  (PDT) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 11/10 (PDT) (beginning of maintenance) 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0423ecb907e7a5be4af6eb6f28fc5ea09d7478f5.png[/img]

[h2][b]PARTY CRASHERS[/b][/h2]
In the limited-time Urgent Quest, [i]TRICK OR TREAT[/i], you’ll need to help clear out an area on Lillipa that was to be a party venue for Arks. However, rampaging Falspawn and Automata apparently decided to crash the party, and ARKS HQ needs 8 operatives to take on the role of bouncer (role, not class) to eject the unwelcome guests.  The festival was going to include the use of Turrets and Energy Tanks (don’t ask how) so the presence of these should be helpful in clearing out the interlopers. Those of you who come wearing something special will be eligible for a [i]PSE OUTFIT BONUS EFFECT[/i]! This boost will net operatives [b]increased EXP gain[/b] as well as an [b]increased rare item drop rate[/b] for the duration of their current instance of [b]Trick or Treat[/b]! So before heading to the Quest Counter, check to see if you have any of the items in [url=https://pso2.com/news/announcements/scarewear1014]this[/url] article!

[h2][b]FRANCA’S AFTER DARK[/b][/h2]
If you’re looking for a great spot to host your own Costume Party, then Franca’s has got you covered. Watch fireworks flit across the City skyline while sipping drinks from a nearby bar and reclining in alcoves alongside the infinity-edge pool. We’re certain at least a few Arks will prefer this over the Lobby as the new gathering place! Just don’t be spooked if a few friendly ghosts prefer it too!

[b]Begins:[/b] 10/13 (PDT) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/08 (PDT) (beginning of maintenance)

Xia’s trying to get ready for the costume-party, but she needs a few things done first! Help her out with these Halloween-themed Client Orders, and you’ll eventually receive some [i]RISING WEAPONS BADGE[/i] 4 and the below item!

[h2][b]BEWARE THE LANTERN RAPPY (AND EMPERAPPY)![/b][/h2]

[h2][b]GHOSTLY BINGO![/b][/h2]
Who doesn’t love Bingo when there are prizes up for grabs?! Probably not Arks, which is good, because they’ll be able to access the [i]HALLOWEEN 2020 BINGO[/i] card in the Halloween Event. As you take on quests, you’ll be informed when you’ve completed a task and the Bingo square number will be briefly displayed at the bottom of your screen. Your ARKS Bingo Card can be accessed through the main menu, then selecting “Current Events” and “ARKS Bingo Card.” To view what tasks you have yet to complete, click on the name of the ARKS Bingo Card–in this case “Halloween 2020 Bingo”–and select “View Details.” The tab that displays by default is named “View Bingo Card,” and this is where you can view remaining squares to be completed. The other Tab is named “Bingo Completion Reward” and this is where you view what rewards you have yet to receive. Finally, the number of times you get a “BINGO” –all squares completed in a straight line, may or may not include the “Free” space in the middle– may qualify you for one of the rewards listed below!

[h2][b]ADDITIONAL CONTENT COMING ON OCTOBER 14TH![/b][/h2]
Ever fancy a walk in the woods, at night? If so, then check out the spooky new Expedition, [b]Bewitched Woods[/b], which fits perfectly with the Halloween theme. A massive, winding forest has appeared on Omega and it’s up to you (and up to 11 other operatives) to chart its paths and determine its hazards. Minotaurqz, Omega Salamanders, Omega Dark Falz, and others are hiding in the gnarled trees, so beware of potential ambushes. This Expedition isn’t all risk and no reward though, as the items these enemies have upon their persons are often of great value; items like the [i]CHAOS MALOSSISTONE[/i] (used in Zig products for Supernatural weapons), for instance. ARKS HQ has mandated that in order to venture into these frightful woods, you’ll need to be at least level 55 and have cleared a particular Client Order. notes.title: AC & FUN SCRATCH TICKETS: LEGENDARY HEROES
notes.content:
[b]Step out of legend with these heroic looks from the new AC Scratch collection, Legendary Heroes, available starting on September 30th! Check out this article for more details![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/af4834fed668fd960e82ac774eac60c691a2e7b0.jpg[/img]

As ARKS Operatives are heroes to so many, inhabitants of the Fleet and Harukotan, Lillipans, and those residing in Omega, it is only fitting that they look the part. In the case of Omega, operatives seem to have stepped from the pages of legend, making them [i]LEGENDARY HEROES[/i], which happens to be the title of the next AC Scratch Ticket collection. This collection features regal pieces that are sure to inspire others to look upon operatives with a mixture of wonder and pride. Get your favorites from this collection [b]between September 30th and October 27th[/b], before the book is closed!

[previewyoutube=GpGDhvO85v0;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside this AC Scratch Ticket collection comes Part 3 of the FUN Scratch lineup for September! Check out the FUN pieces further below!

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets, and [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/fun]here[/url] for some information on FUN Points and what you can do with them!

Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the [b]Legendary Heroes[/b] collection!

notes.title: WHAT’S NEW IN EPISODE 5
notes.content:
[b]If you’re ready for a phantastical adventure, then prepare yourselves operatives, because Episode 5 launches on September 30th! Read this article for details on what’s included![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8eb2ac179d8a9fbe718a11b0df059b1ec9758312.jpg[/img]

The time for [i]EPISODE 5[/i] is drawing nigh, and operatives should prepare for its arrival on [b]September 30th[/b]!

Finding yourself on a fog-enshrouded, flower-dotted plain, a strong sense of displacement and confusion fills you. You had been mid-battle with the Profound Darkness, yet again, in an attempt to sever its corruptive hold on Persona. Suddenly, you feel the vibration of riders approaching, and spot a girl astride a scaled mount, fleeing other riders atop similar beasts. A confrontation seems imminent, and you briefly have time to reflect on what this new mystery will bring in the way of adventure.

Episode 5 brings quite a bit of new content and features, and though you have but a few moments before the party is upon you, you muse over the changes that are to take place on [b]September 30th[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f23dab5ba018e8110aed5428ec9a9a4a4d4b7e4e.png[/img]
[h2][b]WHAT’S NEW[/b][/h2]
Some of the new changes and features include: 

[list]
[*]Player Level cap increased to 90
[*]New ARKS Missions
[*]New Seasonal Events
[*]New Alliance Quarters
[*]Exciting new Titles to earn
[*]New Collection Folder
[*]New quest types
[*]New areas to explore
[*]New S-Grade Augments
[*]Ability to transfer S-Grade Augments
[*]Ability to add a L-Ring Skill to ★12 Units
[/list]

A few of the new features and changes deserve to have a little bit more said about them, so let’s get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/296328d1f8bb0bc480a0b68d018bd081e78612f1.png[/img]
[h2][b]NEW STORY[/b][/h2]
After lending aid to those on Earth, ARKS discovers a mysteriously created portal that leads to another dimension, called “Omega.” This world seems driven purely by fantasy, a world of swords and magic instead of technology and science. The two worlds are in direct contrast with each other, and as the story progresses the player will frequently move between them while observing the strange similarities these worlds share. Simultaneously, a mysterious woman who calls herself “Alma” appears, and she seems to have information about Omega and–strangely–about ARKS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8668823a1d203608f3be8df27b651a2d06b5f323.png[/img]
[h2][b]SCION CLASS - HERO[/b][/h2]
A new type of class has come to Fleet Oracle, the [i]HERO CLASS.[/i] Heroes are trained in the use of several weapons, including: Swords, Twin Machine Guns, and Talises. But this class wouldn’t be the powerhouse it is if the Hero wielded these weapons in the style of other classes. No, their methods are unique amongst the Classes, in that Twin Machine Guns are suitable for ranged combat and can grant PP recovery mid-fight, Talises grant the Hero the ability to move to pre-determined locations at high-speed, and Swords decimate packs of enemies with a wide-range attack. Perhaps most interestingly, Heroes possess specific Photon Arts that allow them to quickly change between all three weapon types while in combat, making the Hero a self-reliant whirlwind of destruction that can adapt to changing situations on the battlefield with ease.

[b]Notable Photon Arts of the Hero include:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Trickflash[/b] – Sword Photon Art for Heroes. Execute a high-speed thrust. Holding the button will swap to your Talis and unleash a follow-up strike.
[*][b]Jet Wheel[/b] - Talis Photon Art for Heroes. Deploys a shuriken which spins about, slicing up targets. The shuriken remains active even if you swap to another Hero weapon.
[*][b]Starfire Squall[/b] – Twin Machine Guns Photon Art for Heroes. Pelt enemies with a one-handed barrage of fire. Performing this Photon Art after dodging an attack will increase its damage.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f8fb2afdf97f26e0309ffde31cd6407d066f1ffa.png[/img]
[h2][b]DARK BLAST[/b][/h2]
By harnessing the power that you’ve accumulated from Dark Falz, you are able to perform an ability called [i]DARK BLAST[/i]. During Dark Blast, your HP and other basic traits are greatly enhanced, and different, more powerful attacks become available to you. Dark Blast is only useable once per quest, and the ability to use it depends on the status of a gauge that fills as you fight enemies. Once in Dark Blast Form, you’re able to use any special Dark Blast skills you may have acquired after spending accumulated [b]Special EXP,[/b] which is built up by defeating enemies in a quest and gained upon quest completion.

[b]DARK BLAST ABILITIES[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Dark Barrier[/b] – raises a large Photon wall in front of you, which draws enemy attacks.
[*][b]Ultimate Impact[/b] – Only useable once per transformation, this skill allows you to channel Photon energy into your arms and release it in a focused blast of destruction. Has a large area of effect and deals extreme damage.
[*][b]HP Up[/b] – Boosts your Max HP.
[/list]

[b]ADDITIONAL DARK BLAST SKILLS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Extend Normal Attack Combo ½[/b] - add extra stages to your Normal Attacks, such as a fourth attack.
[*][b]Bloody Heal[/b] – Recovers HP for you and allies around you.
[*][b]Physical Dash[/b] – Dash at high Speed for a limited time.
[/list]

[b]SPECIAL DARK BLAST PHOTON ARTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Punishment Knuckle[/b] - Unleash a devastating punch after charging. Charging results in greatly enhanced attack power. So powerful that Demon Bulwarks in Buster Quests take only one punch to destroy.
[/list]


[h2][b]A WORLD DIVIDED - OMEGA[/b][/h2]
The world of Omega is divided amongst 4 nations.

[b]CUENTO[/b], a land of nature and magic; but also a land embroiled in civil war between those on the side of righteousness in the Revolutionary Army, and those who back a Pretender to the throne who seeks personal gain through any means necessary. This includes the consumption of Ephemera to fuel an unquenchable thirst for power, and obstinately ignoring the maddening effect Ephemera has on the user. Absolute power corrupts absolutely, after all.

[b]WEYLAND[/b] is a land of parched plains and billowing dust. The wind, as it whittles the landscape, also whittles the people who reside there, molding them into volatile, combative, hardened warriors who are also experiencing civil unrest. Having attained his position through combat with all who would oppose them, their Emperor is not content to rule in peace, but would rather continue to challenge any he deems as worthy adversaries. Some would say this continual thirst for needless bloodshed borders on madness.

[b]EPYK[/b], a land of extremes in both its geology and people. The terrain vacillates between lush oases and barren dunes, while the people (and their Queen) are mercurial in temperament and passionate by nature. The Queen of Epyk craves excitement in her sand-filled days and may look to current events to get it. 

[b]YS ARTIA[/b] is a forest-dotted woodland, with green rolling hills and ocean breezes that invite visitors and residents alike to savor peace and tranquility; making it a popular destination for those wishing to relax. Their newly ascended Symbol wishes the same, but the demands of governing weigh heavy on his young shoulders and he has become resigned to his administrative future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c2fa3e6370bbe1090bf210c0aa3696cc1bd2fde3.png[/img]
[h2][b]NEW ENEMIES – SUPERNATURALS[/b][/h2]
[i]SUPERNATURALS[/i] are a new foe for ARKS Operatives and are created by way of sorcerous summoning–catalyzed by Ephemera. Our research thus far shows that in general, the group does not seem to have any kind of shared weakness, and instead seem to have weaknesses dependent on their individual characteristics. Operatives have encountered the Omega Wolf, Foi Sorcerers, and Resta Golems so far.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/5e1c3cbc3860a956b104c59c8055843697f76ce2.png[/img]
[h2][b]NEW QUEST TYPE – BUSTER QUEST[/b][/h2]
Perhaps the most formidable of Supernaturals, the Castrum Demonica is a fortification capable of summoning an endless wave of creatures and Demonic Arms such as Conjured Artillery, Ephemera Cores, and Demon Artillery. Though the Castrum Demonica are greatly feared, it has been shown that Guardians are able to control a siege weapon called a [i]BUSTER TOWER[/i]. This will potentially change the fate of Omega, as those who seek to do good by restoring the land to a peace known before the appearance of Ephemera can now take a stand against those who seek domination.
 
[b]Features of Buster Quests:[/b]
[list]
[*]On a team of 8 operatives, you will alternate between the Defense Phase and the Buster Phase.
[*]Defense Phases require defending your siege bases, known as Buster Towers, from enemies.
[*]Buster Phases entail attacking the front line and protecting BUSTER PILES–weaponry needed to assault the walls of the Castrum Demonica.
[*]Mana collected from the field is used for a variety of large-scale ARKS weaponry and support abilities.
[*]As your number of cleared Buster Quests grows, your GRADE increases. A higher Grade means better rewards.
[*]In general, you will be matched with operatives who have a similar grade.
[/list]

[h3][b]Featured Rewards[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/24eee5eb7755fe12d7004f3915dbf17552f1b07b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/59d0b6aa271864dadaf80e20088e9576209ff69a.png[/img][/url]

[b]and Cleasis Boosters![/b]


[h2][b]BUSTER MEDAL EXCHANGE SHOP[/b][/h2]
[i]BUSTER MEDALS[/i] can be collected in Buster Quests as well, and these can be used as currency at the [i]BUSTER MEDAL EXCHANGE SHOP[/i].

The below weapons show different upgrade stages of the ★13 Sword, Ivlida Hander, which can be obtained via Buster Quests. With the collection and submission of 60 [i]CLEASIS BOOSTERS[/i] (also obtained from Buster Quests) alongside an Ivlida Hander to [b]Zig[/b] in the [b]Shopping Plaza[/b], the Cleasis Hander shown below will be obtained. Similarly, after 60 [i]SCHVELLE BOOSTERS[/i] have been collected and handed in (by giving Zig 10 Cleasis Boosters for 1 Schvelle Booster) alongside a Cleasis Hander, the Schvelle Hander shown below will be obtained.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/bdd81fec6489916a5f04f4d0679e9e69f427f57e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a624ef91b556c0f405d52b3b8a3c7fcab277738f.png[/img][/url]

There are many different types of Ivlida Weapons that can be upgraded in this way, so get your favorite and start collecting Cleasis Boosters!


[h2][b]RISING WEAPONS BADGE 4[/b][/h2]
The next Rising Weapons Badge, and the wares that can be purchased with them, are here!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1a808cad6c0e4185ddd76deabe03111691833c95.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/cba48cc4cf2cf6e822f0e4668ce19aaee4e56087.png[/img][/url]

Jutus Harmony | Harmonizer, ★13

We hope you’ve enjoyed this glimpse of the content in Episode 5, and hope you’ll join us [b]September 30th[/b] when the real fun begins! See you in a Buster Quest, Arks!

notes.title: SG SCRATCH TICKET: MOTHER’S DISCIPLES
notes.content:
Hot off the streets of Earth, the SG Scratch Mother’s Disciples will arrive on Fleet Oracle on September 9th! See this article for more details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/92ee94174d97d63dd9bb521e8db2fd69a5f1b166.jpg[/img]

Mother’s goals may be questionable, but her taste in fashion is not! Introducing the next SG Scratch ticket collection, [i]MOTHER’S DISCIPLES[/i], with tickets available from a Visiphone near you on [b]September 9th[/b]! With statement buckles, flashy angles, and contrasting colors, this collection is sure to give you an “aethereal” look!

[previewyoutube=zAUVB-yXA3c;full][/previewyoutube]

Click [url=https://pso2.com/news/blogs/scratchtickets]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets. By purchasing SG Scratch Tickets you have a chance to obtain special items, including Layering Pieces, Accessories, Weapon Camos, and Enhancement Items!

[h2][b]SG SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an SG Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the Mother's Disciples Collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 09/09, 12:00 AM (PDT)
[b]Ends:[/b] 03/09, 11:00 PM (PDT) (2021)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 80 SG
[i]*Release date and time are subject to change due to server maintenance.[/i]

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: STAR KEEPER
notes.content:
[b]Prepare yourselves for another AC Scratch, operatives! Star Keeper arrives on August 26th and these looks pair nicely with the newly released Episode 4 content! See this article for more details![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/3df1a27252d049596c182e1a82dbb4440b0f3b0f.jpg[/img]

If you find yourself wanting to emulate the looks of some of the characters from Episode 4, then you’re in luck, because many of these items can be yours with the arrival of the next [i]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/i]–[b]Star Keeper[/b]! These pieces are out of this world (which is true, because they’re from Earth) and you’re sure to be the target of everyone’s gaze while wearing them. This collection also features some of the finest accessories to really make a statement with your fashion.  Fortunately, you don’t have to wait long, only until [b]August 26th[/b]! So be sure to save some room in your closet for your new favorite items!

[previewyoutube=bcda5XPFdJA;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets! By purchasing AC Scratch Tickets you have a chance to obtain special items, including Outfits, Accessories, and Enhancement Items!

[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from [b]Star Keeper[/b]!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 08/26 04:00 PM (Asia/Tokyo)
[b]Ends:[/b] 09/23 03:00 PM (Asia/Tokyo)

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: EARTH DEFENDERS
notes.content:
[b]Ready for a new you? Then prepare for the latest AC Scratch ticket collection, Earth Defenders, arriving August 19th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/34fc78ccf6a6f6fc26c31c0f4aa96d102122595e.jpg[/img]

With the arrival of Episode 4, we’ve all gotten a good look at some of the trends the new ARKS crew-members prefer, and many of you have asked when you’d be able to get your hands on some similar threads. Well, ARKS HQ has heard you, and would like to announce the release of the latest AC Scratch Ticket collection, [i]EARTH DEFENDERS[/i], on August 19th!

[previewyoutube=XGuxPt2DCeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets! By purchasing AC Scratch Tickets you have a chance to obtain special items, including Outfits, Accessories, and Enhancement Items!

[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the [b]Earth Defenders[/b] Collection!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 08/19, 12:00 AM (PDT)
[b]Ends:[/b] 09/15, 11:00 PM (PDT)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC
[i]*Release date and time are subject to change due to server maintenance.[/i]

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: PERSONA PARADOX
notes.content:
[b]The newest AC Scratch Ticket collaboration is here, bringing items from multiple titles of the legendary Persona series! Read this article for more details![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a933ab6494bbbb09acc92f59994a4bce2b163fe9.jpg[/img]

Prepare to face your true self, Arks! We are proud to announce our newest AC Scratch Ticket collaboration, featuring items from the acclaimed Atlus’ JRPG series, Persona! The [i]PERSONA PARADOX [/i]has come to Phantasy Star Online 2 as of [b]August 12th![/b]

Join S.E.E.S, the Investigation Team, and the Phantom Thieves with iconic outfits, music tracks, and more from [i]Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 3, Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4, Persona 5, Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight, and Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight[/i] packed into a single release!

[previewyoutube=S80zcZyoq4s;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from [b]ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG)[/b], and [b]FUN Points.[/b] Click [url=https://pso2.com/news/blogs/scratchtickets]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets! By purchasing AC Scratch Tickets you have a chance to obtain special items, including Outfits, Accessories, and Enhancement Items!

[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from [b]Persona Paradox![/b]

[b]Release Date:[/b] 08/12 04:00 PM (Asia/Tokyo)
[b]Ends:[/b] 09/09 03:00 PM (Asia/Tokyo)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC

[i]*Release date and time are subject to change due to server maintenance.[/i]
